font.title: Font
font.description: Font viewer / comparison tab: an editable preview string rendered simultaneously across a list of chosen fonts (16pt preview + a small alphabet/digits/symbols specimen), a size slider and bold/italic/underline toggles, a details panel of the selected font's metadata (identity, style & metrics, licensing / embedding rights, glyph counts) and a lazy glyph map. Fonts come from the installed set via a themed picker overlay or from files; .ttf/.otf/.ttc load directly and .woff is decoded to sfnt. Opens blank (compare) or preloaded via the 'As Font' action (/font).

font-compare.title: Compare list
font-compare.description: Editable preview text rendered across every chosen font — a 16pt preview (left) plus a small alphabet / digits / symbols specimen (right) per row — with a size slider and bold/italic/underline toggles applied live to all previews.

font-picker.title: Font picker
font-picker.description: Themed shell-modal overlay to add a font: a searchable, virtualized list of installed system families each previewing itself, plus a 'Load from file…' route. Enumerated off the UI thread.

font-details.title: Details panel
font-details.description: Metadata for the selected font read from its GlyphTypeface: identity (family / face / format / faces-in-file), per-face style & metrics (weight/style/stretch, glyph + mapped-char counts, cap/x-height, underline/strikethrough), legal & licensing (copyright, embedding rights) and technical fields — with a face-variant chip strip.

font-glyphmap.title: Glyph map
font-glyphmap.description: A lazy, capped grid of the selected font's glyphs (from its character map) rendered in that face, in a collapsible expander — capped so a large CJK font doesn't realise tens of thousands of cells.

font-open.title: Open As Font
font-open.description: Entry points into the viewer: the 'As Font' file action (/font) and the extension → /font default-open mapping (.ttf/.otf/.ttc/.woff), plus the standalone blank-compare tab. Opening a file preloads and preselects it.

font-decode.title: Font decode pipeline
font-decode.description: Generic preprocessing that turns a wrapped web-font into raw sfnt WPF can load: a decoder registry with a WOFF (zlib) decoder today, written to a temp file and returned as a Uri. WOFF2 is a future drop-in (Brotli + table-transform reversal) — one more decoder + a filemap line.

font-ai.title: AI tools
font-ai.description: The font page's AI surface: GetContext lists the compared fonts (1-based index + source), the preview text + point size + style, and the small specimen line; plus two read-only client tools — get_font_details (full metadata for any listed font) and render_font_preview (a PNG of any listed font's sample + specimen so the model can see the glyph shapes). Reference a font by index or name.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Pluggable LLM backends. Each implements ILlmProvider from Providers.Common and is loaded by ProviderManager; model-bound instances are pooled per (type+config+model).

code.title: Code
code.description: The 'As Code' editor tab: a syntax-highlighted, foldable, editable code editor with a structure (code map / class diagram) side panel, opened on a file via the As Code file action.

images.title: Images
images.description: Tabbed image viewer: opens one image, a selection, or a whole folder with four display modes, slideshow auto-advance, rotate/fit/full-screen tools, navigation and per-image delete.

web-viewer.title: Web Viewer
web-viewer.description: WebView2 browser tab — embeds Edge to render http(s) URLs and local .html/.url files, with navigation chrome, a runtime-missing fallback, and AI page-context tools. Ships and works today (the prior 'faulted' mark was stale).

windowsapps.title: Installed Apps
windowsapps.description: An "Add or remove programs" style tab: a sortable, filterable list of every installed Win32 and Microsoft Store app, with per-row uninstall, open-location and cleanup actions, plus AI context and tools.

win-registry.title: Win Registry
win-registry.description: A registry browser/editor tab: a hive-rooted key tree, a value list, in-tab create/rename/delete of keys and modify/new/delete of values (writes run in-process with an elevation-bridge fallback and confirmation/approval gates), .reg export/import, and four AI registry tools.

win-search.title: Win Search
win-search.description: A Windows Search results tab driven from the file explorer: a parsed query (globs, quoted phrases, +/- prefixes, property/size/date filters) is run against the SystemIndex via OLE DB, scoped to a folder root or across all drives. Results list with open-location / open-file actions and sortable columns; the AI '?' query handler launches and refines searches.

ollama.title: Ollama
ollama.description: Ollama REST API for locally-hosted models.

aria.title: Aria
aria.description: Local Aria service over a Windows named pipe (AriaNamedPipeClient + AriaClientService).

view-hex.title: View Hex
view-hex.description: Hex editor tab: address + hex-bytes panel and a decoded-text pane over a windowed piece-table buffer, with edit modes, goto, undo/redo and save.

viewlet.title: .NET Viewlet
viewlet.description: Inline SingleBar shown above the file list when the open folder holds a .sln/.slnx or a project file — a toolbar of one-click dotnet verbs, a target picker, a transient ✓/✗ status, a NuGet-update caution, plus dotnet tools fed to the AI.

viewlet-2.title: Git Viewlet
viewlet-2.description: Inline SingleBar shown above the file list when the open folder contains a .git — surfaces branch, working-tree status, last commit and one-click branch/pull, plus read-only git tools fed to the AI.

common.title: Common / Shared
common.description: Cross-cutting libraries used by Core and many features. Each versions and evolves independently of any single feature, so each gets its own entry here.

parsers.title: Parsers
parsers.description: Per-language tree-sitter support. Highlighting + folding cover ~16 grammars; a subset of these also have a structure extractor that powers the code map / class view. Detected injection sites for not-yet-shipped targets (SQL, GraphQL) light up automatically once their grammar is added.

class-view.title: Class view
class-view.description: The Mermaid classDiagram inside the code map: one box per declared type with its members (visibility marker + abbreviated signature) and inheritance/realization edges. Member rows are clickable links that jump the editor to the definition line; embedded languages render as linked namespace sub-graphs.

c.title: C#
c.description: C# (.cs/.csx): tree-sitter highlighting + folding and a full structure extractor (types, members, visibility, inheritance) for the class view.

ruby.title: Ruby
ruby.description: Ruby (.rb/.rake/.gemspec/.ru …): tree-sitter highlighting + folding and a structure extractor (classes/modules, methods, require_relative deps); also a heredoc injection host for embedded HTML/CSS/JS/JSON/ERB.

code-view.title: Code View
code-view.description: The editor surface — AvalonEdit text area hosting the file's content with monospace font, line-number gutter, undo/redo, dirty tracking and selection. Editable up to the size ceiling, read-only beyond it.

pty-terminal.title: PTY Terminal
pty-terminal.description: A live cmd.exe pseudo-console: type straight into the shell, see VT screen + scrollback, with a top path bar and a 'running…' indicator.

displaymodes.title: Display Modes
displaymodes.description: Segmented selector in the top toolbar that switches the content pane between the four sub-views (shown only when more than one image is loaded).

album.title: Album
album.description: Wrapping grid of thumbnail cards; single-click selects, double-click opens that image in the carousel.

carousel.title: Carousel
carousel.description: One-image-at-a-time view with fit-to-window/actual-size framing, prev/next arrows, wheel/arrow-key stepping and a dot position indicator. The default mode.

hybrid-album.title: Explore (Hybrid Album)
hybrid-album.description: Split view: a wrapping thumbnail strip on the left and the selected image (with rotate/fit tools) on the right; clicking a thumb or wheeling the image pane changes the selection.

collage.title: Collage
collage.description: Scattered, tilted thumbnail cards on a pan/zoom canvas; drag to pan, wheel to zoom (cursor-anchored), double-click a card to open it in the carousel.

view-json.title: View Json
view-json.description: Virtualizing structured JSON viewer: a flat display list backed by a tree model with toolbar view modes, JSONPath breadcrumb, expand/collapse, drag-reorder edit, format and save.

view-apps.title: View Apps
view-apps.description: The app list itself: a virtualized GridView ListView showing Name, Publisher, Version, Installed date, Size, and Source for every discovered app, aggregating both discovery sources into one list. Extended multi-select feeds the selected rows to the AI as context.

elevated-uninstaller.title: Uninstall
elevated-uninstaller.description: Removes the selected app after a confirmation dialog. Win32 apps run the vendor-registered UninstallString (interactive, may self-elevate; MSI /I is rewritten to /X and the exit code interpreted); Store apps are removed via RemovePackageAsync. On success the list re-scans; failures surface the uninstaller's reason.

cleanup-broken.title: Remove from list
cleanup-broken.description: For orphaned Win32 entries only (no install folder and no runnable uninstaller): deletes the leftover Uninstall registry record after confirmation, without touching any files. Deleting an HKLM entry needs elevation and fails gracefully (error shown) if access is denied.

windows-store-apps.title: Windows Store Apps
windows-store-apps.description: Discovery source for Microsoft Store / UWP (MSIX) packages installed for the current user, enumerated via the WinRT PackageManager. Framework, resource and OS-system packages are hidden; rows are tagged Source = "Store".

registry-apps.title: Registry Apps
registry-apps.description: Discovery source for traditional Win32 programs read from the three Uninstall registry hives (HKLM 64-bit, HKLM 32-bit WOW node, HKCU). Mirrors what Windows shows: OS components, updates and child entries are filtered out; rows are tagged Source = "Win32".

sunburst-view.title: Sunburst View
sunburst-view.description: Radial chart of the component tree (depth-2 from focus) with arcs coloured by an Accent gradient and a status marker bar; click an arc to focus, the centre to zoom out, right-click for the node menu.

data-model.title: Data model
data-model.description: On-disk .product/ store: product.json (ProductDocument: name, concern vocabulary, export dir) + tree.json (flat node dictionary), plus frozen snapshots in the export dir.

canvas-view.title: Canvas View
canvas-view.description: Infinite corkboard surface — a transform-scaled Canvas of post-it notes over a tiled grid background, with pan, zoom and a minimap; double-clicking the canvas deliberately does nothing (notes come from the toolbar, context menu, paste or drop).

universal-drop-target.title: Universal Drop Target
universal-drop-target.description: Drag-drop or paste anything onto the board and it becomes the right kind of note: image file → embedded image, other file/folder → clickable link, raw bitmap → embedded PNG, bare URL → preview card, text → markdown. Accepts OS drops (positioned), intra-app drops (centred) and Ctrl+V.

minimap-navigation.title: Minimap Navigation
minimap-navigation.description: Top-left overview that appears only when notes lie off-screen: draws every note as a colour swatch with a blue viewport rectangle; drag anywhere on it to recentre the view on that point.

recycle-bin.title: Recycle Bin
recycle-bin.description: Expired or removed notes move to a right-side recycle-bin panel (toggled from the toolbar split button) where each can be Restored or permanently Deleted; the dropdown's Empty Recycle Bin clears all (confirmation-gated). Notes auto-purge after the configured retention period.

shapes.title: Shapes
shapes.description: A note's silhouette, chosen from the mini-ribbon: Square, Rounded, Diagonals (one rounded diagonal) or Speech bubble. Applied as a geometry clip on the note body, with the speech tail drawn as a separate path.

rounded.title: Rounded
rounded.description: Rounded-rectangle silhouette (14px corner radius) — the default shape for new notes.

diagonal.title: Diagonals
diagonal.description: Diagonally-rounded silhouette: top-left and bottom-right corners rounded, the other two sharp. Also the fixed look of AI-authored notes.

speech.title: Speech Bubble
speech.description: Rounded body with a triangular tail bolted onto the bottom edge (drawn behind the body as a separate themed path so the body keeps full resize + text area).

view-table.title: View table
view-table.description: The virtualized grid: a sticky column-header strip plus a pooled set of ~150 row visuals that show the current window slice; alternating row stripes and a detected-shape descriptor line above.

parser.title: Parser
parser.description: Tokenizes each line into cells: RFC-4180-ish CSV with optional quoting, raw delimiter split, or fixed-width slicing. Backs every detected separator shape.

csv.title: CSV
csv.description: Comma-separated detection + quoted-field tokenizing (double-quote escapes a literal quote). Also covers semicolon/pipe-separated variants.

tsv.title: TSV
tsv.description: Tab-separated detection — a candidate separator in the detector, parsed by the same tokenizer.

sysinfoview.title: Dashboard
sysinfoview.description: The System Info tab itself: scrolling dashboard of card sections gathered off the UI thread from WMI/registry/native calls, with a header bar (title, animated 'Gathering…' status, Refresh) and a wrapping panel of section cards.

operating-system.title: Operating System
operating-system.description: OS card: edition/caption, display version + build/UBR (from registry), architecture, computer name, logged-in user, registered owner, install date, last boot, uptime, time zone and system locale.

panels.title: Dashboard Panels
panels.description: The set of card sections shown on the dashboard — each a titled group of label→value facts whose value colour reflects an advisory health status (Good/Warning/Bad/Neutral). Built by SystemInfoCollector, every probe independently fault-tolerant so one unavailable source degrades to '—' rather than blanking the dashboard.

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.description: Hardware card: system maker/model, motherboard, CPU name with cores/threads/sockets and max clock, total + in-use memory, DIMM count/speed, BIOS vendor/version/date, firmware type (UEFI/Legacy) and serial number.

display.title: Display
display.description: Display card: each GPU with true VRAM (read from the driver registry key, not the wrapped WMI uint32), current resolution + refresh rate and driver version, plus friendly monitor names decoded from root\wmi WmiMonitorID.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Wide storage card: physical disks (model, size, SSD/fixed media, interface) followed by ready logical volumes with label, free/total space, free-% (amber under 10%) and file-system format.

windows-security.title: Windows Security
windows-security.description: Security-posture card: Secure Boot, Virtualization-based Security (VBS), Memory Integrity (HVCI), Credential Guard, Kernel DMA Protection and TPM presence/version — each colour-coded green/amber. TPM read via the TBS API and Secure Boot via the registry so the card works without elevation.

process-view.title: Process View
process-view.description: The live process list/grid — one row per process with Name, CPU, Private bytes, Memory (working set), PID, Description and Company columns; samples the system once a second while active.

tree-vs-list.title: Tree vs List
tree-vs-list.description: The 'Tree' toggle groups processes by parent → child hierarchy (default on); off shows a flat list. Cycle protection prevents parent-chain loops; filtering always collapses to a flat match list.

expand-collapse-all.title: Expand / Collapse All
expand-collapse-all.description: In tree mode, per-row chevron expanders plus 'Expand all' / 'Collapse all' buttons that set every node's expansion state at once (rows start collapsed).

live-vs-pause.title: Live vs Pause
live-vs-pause.description: The '● Live' toggle auto-refreshes the snapshot once per second while the tab is active; turning it off freezes the view. The 'Refresh now' (↻) button takes a single fresh sample on demand.

filter.title: Search / Filter
filter.description: The search box filters processes by name, PID, company, description or path substring (case-insensitive); a clear (✕) button resets it. While filtering, results show as a flat match list regardless of tree mode.

details-view.title: Details View
details-view.description: The per-process inspector tab (opened by double-click or 'View details'), with a header bar (live toggle, refresh-now, Kill) and vertical sub-tabs: General, Performance, Threads, Modules, Handles. Shows an 'exited' overlay when the process is gone.

general-info.title: General Info
general-info.description: General sub-tab: selectable Image, Description, Company, Version, Path (with Copy), Command line (with Copy), User, Parent, Architecture/started, and a Priority dropdown that re-prioritises the process when changed.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Performance sub-tab: an auto-scaled CPU-usage sparkline (60-sample history) plus metric tiles for private bytes, working set, peak working set, thread count, handle count, GDI objects and USER objects.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Threads sub-tab: a list of the process's threads (TID, state, priority, CPU time, start time) reconciled in place each tick; per-row Copy context menu; shows an admin-required banner when thread details can't be read.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Modules sub-tab: the loaded DLLs/modules with sortable, resizable Module/Version/Size/Path columns and a per-row context menu (Open file location, Copy path). An admin-required banner offers 'Load with admin' to re-read a protected process's modules.

handles.title: Handles
handles.description: Handles sub-tab: open handles (Type, Handle, Access, Name) loaded on demand via one elevated process.inspect (admin); shows a call-to-action, progress and error states, a count + 'Reload (admin)', and a per-row Copy context menu.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: Seven selectable visual themes assembled in layers (palette -> region tokens -> per-theme overrides + scenes -> styles); the user picks one in Options and the window restarts to apply it.

dark.title: Dark
dark.description: Default flat dark Pro theme; palette only, no region overrides or scene, so the shell looks exactly as it did before the theming rework.

title_path: Keeping Dark (and the other plain themes) identical

light.title: Light
light.description: Flat light Pro theme; a soft grey app frame (chrome/tabs/sidebar/AI bar) zones the lighter content canvas, with region overrides but no scene.

title_path: Keeping Dark (and the other plain themes) identical

sunny.title: Sunny
sunny.description: Light immersive theme: a bright sky with drifting balloons/confetti (SunnyScene) shows through translucent white panels behind the whole shell.

title_path: Keeping Dark (and the other plain themes) identical

ocean.title: Ocean
ocean.description: Dark immersive theme: a sunlit-reef Scene.Window (fish, bubbles, coral, god rays) reads through translucent deep-teal glass surfaces across the whole shell.

gothic.title: Gothic
gothic.description: Dark immersive theme: a midnight-tower night (GothicScene — bruised-purple moonlit sky, tower, fog) sits behind translucent surfaces across the whole shell.

title_path: Keeping Dark (and the other plain themes) identical

sandstone.title: Sandstone
sandstone.description: Dark immersive theme: a cut-stone masonry wall lit by a slowly travelling sun (SandstoneWall) sits behind the whole shell.

title_path: Keeping Dark (and the other plain themes) identical

nature.title: Nature
nature.description: Dark immersive theme: a dappled-woodland Scene.Window (ForestScene — sunlit canopy fading to shaded floor) sits behind page and AI-bar surfaces.

title_path: Keeping Dark (and the other plain themes) identical

ribbon.title: Ribbon
ribbon.description: The customisable launcher strip at the top of the shell: a horizontal bar of buttons that each open a page kind, plus separators and an overflow menu, with an inline editor for reordering, styling and adding buttons. Layout is per-profile and live-syncs across every window on the profile.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: App-wide message inbox shared by every window: the source of truth for every notification; opened from the top-bar Messages button (with an unread badge) into a right-anchored panel.

options.title: Options
options.description: Modal settings overlay: a left section list (one per IFeatureConfig) and a right pane that is either a reflection-generated property grid or a feature-supplied custom control, with Save / Cancel in the footer. Save is gated on every section being valid and persists all sections, then requests open tabs to refresh.

workspaces.title: Workspaces & Profiles
workspaces.description: A Profile is a saved, shared config (name/colour/icon + AI ability grid, provider keys, ribbon, conversations); a Workspace is the runtime grouping of windows running ONE profile. The selector switches the active workspace; Options and Configure manage the profile list.

background-tasks.title: Background Tasks
background-tasks.description: Shell-owned collection of in-flight background activities that providers/features report into (StartActivity → Complete/Fail) without touching WPF; surfaced to the user via the activity ticker. Starts/returns to an 'Idle' placeholder when nothing is running.

chat-interface.title: AI Input Bar & Response Overlay
chat-interface.description: The always-present bottom AI bar on every window — status dot, text input with ghost-text completion, send/cancel/queue, mic, page-context toggle — plus the modal response overlay and the in-page dissolvable banner that render the agent's progress, approvals, and final answer.

add-workspace.title: Add Workspace
add-workspace.description: '+ Add Workspace' in Options → Workspaces creates a new profile with a random icon/colour and a unique 'New Workspace' name, then runs the workspace-setup wizard (provider → key → model) for it; the new entry lands at the top of the list.

configure-workspace.title: Configure Workspace
configure-workspace.description: Opens the per-workspace Configure (Manage-AI) panel for a profile: identity page + provider configs + AI ability grid + per-workspace feature settings. Reachable from the Options Workspaces list (⚙ Configure), the selector right-click ('Configure workspace…'), and deep links (e.g. a console page's Configure button).

page-contents-injection.title: Include Page Context Toggle
page-contents-injection.description: The 🔗 toggle (right cluster, on by default) attaches the active page's gathered context to conversational agent calls. On send the turn holds until the page reports its context is ready (showing a 'Waiting for data collection…' line) so the model sees real data.

voice-input.title: Voice Input
voice-input.description: The 🎙 mic button toggles Whisper transcription (turns red while listening); the status dot pulses 'listening' and the input box fills with the live transcript and locks. Enabled only when host capabilities pass and the model is downloaded. Manual click stops early; it also auto-stops.

ai-intent-symbol.title: Intent Symbol / Handler Routing
ai-intent-symbol.description: As the user types, handlers are scored (debounced 150ms): a clear winner shows its single-char symbol in the status dot and offers ghost completion; on send, an explicit Symbol prefix (e.g. '>' → console) routes directly, otherwise the top CanProcess score is used, with the LLM (DisambiguateToolSelection) breaking ties — falling through to the agent loop if nothing matches.

window-handling.title: Window Handling
window-handling.description: Multi-window shell mechanics: tear a tab into its own window, open a page in a new window, split a window into two side-by-side panes, drag tabs across panes and across windows, themed file/folder pickers, and DPI-aware window placement. Extra windows share the same workspace.

tear-off.title: Tear Off Tab
tear-off.description: Drag a tab out of the tab strip and release it off any window (or use the tab's 'Open in New Window' menu) to spawn a fresh shell window containing just that tab, in the SAME workspace. The new window is positioned at the cursor on the correct monitor.

dual-pane.title: Split View (Dual Pane)
dual-pane.description: Split the tab area into two side-by-side panes (v1: a single vertical left/right split, no nesting) with a draggable splitter that keeps each pane at ≥30% width. Split a chosen tab into a new right pane, or split off an empty pane; collapse the split to move all tabs back into the survivor.

launch-control.title: Launch Control
launch-control.description: How the app is launched and routed to a workspace: --context "Name" opens straight into a named profile; single-instance IPC forwards a later launch as a new-window/new-workspace request; --prestart runs a windowless resident daemon; the taskbar JumpList exposes one launch entry per profile.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Audio player tab — NAudio playback with transport, a folder play-queue/playlist, spectrum + waveform visuals, scrolling .lrc lyrics, and an ID3 tag editor with album art. Opens single files, multi-selections, or a whole folder ("Play folder"). Engine is created lazily and survives tab switches; volume + auto-advance persist.

compressed.title: Compressed / Archives
compressed.description: Inspect, browse, extract, edit and rebuild archives. A process-wide VirtualFileSystem makes any registered format browsable like a folder; the inspector tab adds metadata, an action bar (extract/add/test/encrypt/sign/recompress/convert) and folder/file 'Zip It' / 'Unzip here' actions. Backends cover zip, tar, 7z, rar, gzip/bzip2/xz, zstd, lz4, plus AES-256 zip encryption and detached ECDSA signing.

model3d.title: 3D Model
model3d.description: Interactive 3D model viewer tab (HelixToolkit viewport): loads STL/OBJ/3DS/PLY, glTF/glb and a wide range of formats via Assimp (FBX/3MF/AMF/Collada/…), with mouse rotate/zoom/pan, a wireframe toggle, an Alt+right-drag turn gesture, a stats footer, a material inspector, and AI camera/capture tools. Opens via /model3d (ShowModel3DAction).

notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.description: Jupyter .ipynb viewer tab: parses nbformat JSON into ordered cells rendered in place — markdown cells as rendered markdown, code cells syntax-highlighted per the detected kernel language with an In[n] execution label — alongside a per-cell code-structure outline. Opens via /notebook (ShowNotebookAction).

video.title: Video
video.description: Embedded libVLC-4 video player tab: decodes into a WPF bitmap (no native-window airspace), with a transport bar, click-to-pause, a codec/metadata panel, a keyframe scene-strip, fullscreen, and an AI frame-capture tool. Opens via /video (ShowVideoAction) on common video extensions.

aichat.title: AI Chat
aichat.description: Dedicated AI conversation tab — a browser over saved conversations with page-context pinning.

audio-open.title: Open Actions
audio-open.description: Ways to open audio in the player: the "As Audio" file action (single file or multi-selection queue) and the "Play Folder" folder action (whole-folder auto-playing queue).

audio-open-asaudio.title: Open As Audio
audio-open-asaudio.description: File-tree action "As Audio": opens a single audio file alone, or a multi-selection as exactly that queue, in the player tab. Maps to the /audio experience.

audio-open-playfolder.title: Play Folder
audio-open-playfolder.description: Folder action "Play Folder": queues all top-level audio files (name-ordered) and starts playback immediately. Offered when at least 30% of a folder's files are audio.

audio-nowplaying.title: Now Playing
audio-nowplaying.description: Header showing the current track's album art (with a music-note placeholder), title, artist, album, and a queue position counter (e.g. "3 / 12") when more than one track is queued.

audio-transport.title: Transport
audio-transport.description: Playback controls row: previous, play/pause, stop, next, plus a volume slider. Prev/next appear only for a multi-track queue.

audio-playpause.title: Play / Pause
audio-playpause.description: Toggles playback of the current track; glyph flips between play and pause. Lazily creates the playback engine and starts the ~30fps render loop on first play.

audio-stop.title: Stop
audio-stop.description: Stops playback and resets the playhead to the start of the track, clearing the spectrum and lyric highlight.

audio-next.title: Next Track
audio-next.description: Advances to the next track in the queue, keeping playing state. Disabled on the last track.

audio-previous.title: Previous Track
audio-previous.description: Goes to the previous track, but restarts the current track if more than 3 seconds have elapsed (familiar player behaviour). Disabled on the first track.

audio-volume.title: Volume Slider
audio-volume.description: Custom 0..1 volume slider that live-sets engine gain; the last value is persisted to config and restored on the next track.

audio-seek.title: Seek (waveform click)
audio-seek.description: Position + duration readouts under the waveform; clicking the waveform seeks to that 0..1 position in the track and re-syncs the lyric highlight.

audio-autoadvance.title: Auto-advance
audio-autoadvance.description: When a track finishes, automatically plays the next queued track (configurable; on by default). On the last track without auto-advance it just stops at the end.

audio-playlist.title: Playlist Drawer
audio-playlist.description: Left slide-out drawer (toggle shown only for multi-track queues) listing all queued tracks, with the current track accented. Supports double-click to jump/play and drag-to-reorder the queue.

audio-playlist-play.title: Play Playlist Item
audio-playlist-play.description: Double-clicking a playlist row jumps to and plays that track.

audio-playlist-reorder.title: Reorder Playlist (drag)
audio-playlist-reorder.description: Drag a playlist row to a new position to reorder the play queue, keeping the currently-loaded track current.

audio-spectrum.title: Spectrum Analyser
audio-spectrum.description: Live FFT bar visualiser fed band magnitudes each render tick while playing; each bar uses a low→high theme gradient. Bar count is configurable (default 64).

audio-waveform.title: Waveform View
audio-waveform.description: Static peak-envelope waveform of the whole track (analysed off the audio file), drawn split into played vs unplayed by the playhead; doubles as the clickable seek bar.

audio-lyrics.title: Lyrics Panel
audio-lyrics.description: Right-drawer Lyrics view. Synced lyrics from a sibling .lrc file scroll and highlight the active line with the playhead; embedded unsynced lyrics render statically; otherwise shows "No lyrics found."

audio-tageditor.title: Tag Editor
audio-tageditor.description: Right-drawer Tags panel: edit ID3 title/artist/album/year/track/genre/comment plus album art, with a dirty flag; "Save tags" writes back to the file (the engine is released first so TagLib can open it for writing) and reloads.

audio-tageditor-art.title: Album Art (change / remove)
audio-tageditor-art.description: In the Tag editor: preview the embedded cover, "Change art…" to pick a new image (jpg/png/bmp), or "Remove" to clear it; both mark the tags dirty for saving.

code-open-action.title: Open As Code
code-open-action.description: File action 'As Code' that opens the selected file in the code editor tab — the right context for working with a file as code, distinct from the read-only As Text viewer.

code-config.title: Max editable size
code-config.description: Global setting capping the editable file size (5–250 MB, default 50 MB); larger files open read-only with a prompt to view As Text or split them.

code-editor-toolbar.title: Editor toolbar
code-editor-toolbar.description: Top toolbar of the editor surface: encoding selector, line-ending (EOL) selector, line-numbers toggle, and the Save button.

code-encoding.title: Encoding selector
code-encoding.description: Picks the encoding used to read and to save the file (UTF-8, UTF-8 BOM, UTF-16 LE/BE, Latin-1, System Default); auto-synced to the detected encoding on load, re-reading on a manual change.

code-eol.title: Line-ending selector
code-eol.description: Chooses the line terminator written on save — Preserve / LF / CRLF / CR.

code-line-numbers.title: Line numbers toggle
code-line-numbers.description: Toolbar toggle that shows/hides the line-number gutter (themed to the muted text brush).

code-save.title: Save
code-save.description: Saves the buffer with the chosen encoding + EOL (Ctrl+S); writes through the virtual filesystem (plain file or in-archive rewrite) and clears the dirty flag. Disabled when unchanged or read-only.

code-reload.title: Reload (F5) & external-change watch
code-reload.description: F5 reloads from disk (prompting if there are unsaved edits); a file watcher reloads on external change, ignoring the editor's own writes and showing a 'changed on disk' banner.

code-statusbar.title: Status bar
code-statusbar.description: Footer showing file size, an unsaved/read-only indicator, the live line count and the detected line-ending label (LF/CRLF/CR/Mixed); the line indicator opens the Lines command popup.

code-context-menu.title: Cut / Copy / Paste
code-context-menu.description: Editor right-click context menu with the standard clipboard commands.

code-too-large.title: Read-only / too-large banner
code-too-large.description: When a file exceeds the editable-size ceiling or fails to open, the editor goes read-only and shows a warning banner suggesting As Text or splitting the file.

code-commands.title: Editor commands panel
code-commands.description: Floating command panel (top-right) of grouped dropdowns — Checksum, Encode, Decode — over pure text transforms; selection-scoped groups appear only when text is selected so the menu never offers a no-op.

code-checksum.title: Checksum
code-checksum.description: MD5 / SHA-256 of the document or the current selection; result is copied to the clipboard and toasted.

code-base64.title: Base64 encode / decode
code-base64.description: Base64-encodes or -decodes the current selection in place (errors if the selection isn't valid Base64).

code-line-ops.title: Line operations
code-line-ops.description: Footer 'Lines' popup: EOL conversion (LF/CRLF/CR) for any file, plus prose-only line ops (remove empty / dedupe / sort A→Z / Z→A) that are hidden for code & markup.

code-highlighting.title: Syntax highlighting
code-highlighting.description: Colours code by file extension via two engines chosen by the highlighting registry: tree-sitter for real code languages, AvalonEdit .xshd for simple markup/config; everything else stays plain text. All colours resolve from TextSwatch.* theme tokens.

code-treesitter.title: Tree-sitter colouring
code-treesitter.description: For real code languages, a full tree-sitter parse drives colouring: capture names map to TextSwatch.* roles painted only on visible lines, retinting live on a theme switch.

code-xshd.title: Markup (.xshd) colouring
code-xshd.description: Simple markup/config formats AvalonEdit ships a definition for (XML / XAML / XSL …) get token colouring, retinted to the TextSwatch.* palette by XshdTheming.

code-role-palette.title: Role palette
code-role-palette.description: The shared capture→theme-token map (Comment, Keyword, String, Number, Type, Constant, Function, Operator/Parameter, Tag, Attribute) so every theme can art-direct code colours.

code-folding.title: Code folding
code-folding.description: Tree-sitter block-like nodes drive a fold margin with [-]/[+] markers for collapsing/expanding blocks; folds update (debounced) as the buffer changes.

code-embedded.title: Embedded languages
code-embedded.description: A host file embedding another language (JS/CSS in HTML, Ruby in ERB, Python in Jinja, HTML around PHP) is detected and each sub-range re-parsed with a child highlighter, recursing for nesting; the same ranges drive folding, the spliced AST, and the class viewer.

code-syntax-tree-tool.title: Syntax tree (AI tool)
code-syntax-tree-tool.description: AI client tool get_syntax_tree returns the tree-sitter parse tree (s-expression) of the open document for structural understanding; get_editor_text returns the full buffer.

code-map.title: Code map panel
code-map.description: Collapsible markdown side panel (draggable splitter + reopen tab) rendering the file's structure: a Dependencies list, a class diagram, and a free-functions list. Regenerates debounced as the buffer changes; hidden when the file has no code grammar or no structure.

code-map-deps.title: Dependencies list
code-map-deps.description: Imports/includes/requires from the file (and any embedded region); a relative import that resolves to a local file becomes a clickable link that opens that file As Code, others stay plain text.

code-map-members.title: Free functions list
code-map-members.description: A Members list of top-level (free) functions for languages that have them; each entry links to its definition line.

code-map-nav.title: Map navigation
code-map-nav.description: Clicking a code-map link navigates: a same-file member (AST-path fragment) scrolls the editor and places the caret there; another file opens it As Code, optionally seeded to a member. AST paths keep links valid across edits.

code-map-toggle.title: Show/hide map
code-map-toggle.description: Collapse the code-map panel via the header chevron and reopen it via the floating tab; the dragged panel width is remembered across collapses.

parser-js.title: JavaScript
parser-js.description: JavaScript (.js/.mjs/.cjs/.jsx): highlighting + folding and a structure extractor (classes, methods, top-level functions, relative-import deps); embeds GraphQL via tagged templates (no-op until that grammar ships).

parser-ts.title: TypeScript
parser-ts.description: TypeScript (.ts/.cts/.mts): highlighting + folding and a structure extractor (classes/interfaces/enums/type-aliases, accessibility modifiers, type annotations).

parser-python.title: Python
parser-python.description: Python (.py/.pyw): highlighting + folding and a structure extractor (classes, methods, fields, relative-import deps, naming-convention visibility).

parser-java.title: Java
parser-java.description: Java (.java): highlighting + folding and a structure extractor (classes/interfaces/enums/records, methods, fields, extends/implements edges).

parser-cpp.title: C++
parser-cpp.description: C++ (.cpp/.cc/.cxx/.hpp/.hh/.hxx/.ipp): highlighting + folding and a structure extractor (classes/structs/enums, methods, fields, base classes, #include deps).

parser-rust.title: Rust
parser-rust.description: Rust (.rs): highlighting + folding and a structure extractor (structs/enums/traits, impl-block methods accumulated per type, trait-impl edges).

parser-php.title: PHP
parser-php.description: PHP (.php/.phtml): highlighting + folding and a structure extractor (classes/interfaces/traits/enums, methods, properties, consts); combined-injection host for the HTML around <?php ?>.

parser-razor.title: Razor
parser-razor.description: Razor (.razor/.cshtml): highlighting + folding and a structure extractor that surfaces the @code/@functions block as a synthetic 'Code' component type plus any nested C# types.

parser-html.title: HTML
parser-html.description: HTML (.html/.htm): tree-sitter highlighting + folding; injection host that embeds JavaScript in <script> and CSS in <style>. No standalone class structure.

parser-css.title: CSS
parser-css.description: CSS (.css): tree-sitter highlighting + folding; also the target of HTML/ERB/Ruby <style> and heredoc injections.

parser-erb.title: ERB
parser-erb.description: ERB embedded templates (.erb): tree-sitter highlighting + folding; combined-injection host weaving Ruby (<% %>) and HTML across directive boundaries.

parser-jinja.title: Jinja
parser-jinja.description: Jinja templates (.j2/.jinja/.jinja2): parsed with the HTML grammar but routing injection by its own alias id — embeds Python in {{ }}/{% %} (plus HTML script/style).

parser-json.title: JSON
parser-json.description: JSON (.json): tree-sitter highlighting + folding in the code editor (the standalone JSON viewer is a separate feature).

parser-sql-graphql.title: SQL / GraphQL (detected, no grammar)
parser-sql-graphql.description: Injection sites for SQL (Ruby heredoc) and GraphQL (JS/TS tagged templates) are already detected but ship no grammar, so they produce no spans yet — they light up automatically once those grammars are added.

images-collage-minimap.title: Collage Minimap
images-collage-minimap.description: Bottom-right overview box, shown only when the collage extends past the viewport; drag inside it to reposition the canvas.

images-navigation.title: Navigation
images-navigation.description: Moving between images: prev/next arrow buttons, mouse wheel, arrow/space keys, the dot indicator strip and thumbnail selection.

images-prevnext.title: Previous / Next Arrows
images-prevnext.description: Overlaid left/right arrow buttons on the carousel image; step through images and disable at the ends (no wrap).

images-wheel-keys.title: Wheel & Keyboard Stepping
images-wheel-keys.description: Mouse wheel and arrow/space keys step through images in the carousel (clamped at the ends); the Explore image pane also steps on the wheel.

images-dot-indicator.title: Dot Position Indicator
images-dot-indicator.description: Strip of clickable dots under the carousel marking the current image; pages in blocks of 20 with prev/next-20 arrows when there are many images.

images-thumb-select.title: Thumbnail Select / Open
images-thumb-select.description: Single-click a thumbnail (album/explore) to select it; double-click in album or collage jumps to that image and switches to the carousel.

images-tools.title: Image Tools
images-tools.description: Floating top-right toolbar over the featured image (carousel & explore) plus the top toolbar's view button: rotate, fit, and full-screen controls.

images-rotate.title: Rotate Left / Right
images-rotate.description: Two toolbar buttons rotate the displayed image 90° counter-clockwise or clockwise (applied in the tab and full-screen views).

images-fit.title: Fit / Actual Size
images-fit.description: Toggle button switching the image between scaled-to-fit and 100% actual size; actual size shows a scrollable pannable view.

images-fullscreen.title: Full-Screen View
images-fullscreen.description: Opens the current image in a borderless maximised window; Space/→/click advance, ←/right-click go back, Esc exits (and stops auto-advance); stays in sync with rotation and the slideshow.

images-slideshow.title: Slideshow
images-slideshow.description: Auto-advance playback controls in the top toolbar: an Auto toggle and a Slow/Medium/Fast speed slider; the slideshow loops (wraps) on a timer.

images-auto-toggle.title: Auto-Advance Toggle
images-auto-toggle.description: Toolbar toggle that starts/stops timed auto-advance of the slideshow; accent-highlighted when on.

images-speed-slider.title: Speed Slider
images-speed-slider.description: Three-position slider setting the auto-advance interval — Slow (10s), Medium (4s), Fast (1s) — with a live label.

images-delete.title: Delete Image
images-delete.description: Right-click → Delete (on the featured image or any thumbnail) confirms, sends the file to the Recycle Bin, and drops it from every view, re-pointing the selection.

images-thumbnails.title: Thumbnail Loading
images-thumbnails.description: Background-populated thumbnail cards (shell thumbnail cache, 200px) shown across album/explore/collage with a placeholder until each image yields.

images-open-actions.title: Open Actions
images-open-actions.description: Entry points from the file explorer: open a file/selection as images, or open a folder of images as a slideshow or album (folders gated at ≥30% image files).

images-open-as-image.title: Open As Image
images-open-as-image.description: File action 'As Image' opening one or more selected image files (png/jpg/gif/bmp/ico/tiff/webp) in a new viewer tab.

images-open-slideshow.title: Folder Slideshow
images-open-slideshow.description: Folder action 'Slideshow' opening a directory's images in the one-at-a-time carousel (whole-folder breadcrumb).

images-open-album.title: Folder Album
images-open-album.description: Folder action 'Album' opening a directory's images as a scrolling thumbnail grid.

images-exif.title: EXIF / Metadata Panel
images-exif.description: A panel showing the image's EXIF/metadata (dimensions, camera, capture date, GPS). Not implemented — the viewer surfaces only the file name and position.

markdown-open-action.title: Open in Markdown editor
markdown-open-action.description: File-list action on .md / .markdown files that opens a new live-edit Markdown tab (experience id /text/markdown).

markdown-toolbar.title: Editor toolbar
markdown-toolbar.description: Top bar of the Markdown tab: file name, the Source toggle and the Save button.

markdown-filename.title: File name label
markdown-filename.description: Shows the open document's file name in the toolbar (ellipsised when long).

markdown-source-toggle.title: Source toggle
markdown-source-toggle.description: '</> Source' toggle button: off = rendered + inline editing (default), on = raw markdown in one plain text box. Focus moves to whichever surface it reveals.

markdown-save.title: Save button
markdown-save.description: Writes the document back to disk via the VirtualFileSystem; disabled while clean, enabled when dirty. Also bound to Ctrl+S in both modes.

markdown-inline-editor.title: Inline (live) editor
markdown-inline-editor.description: Default surface: the whole document renders as markdown and the block under the caret swaps to its raw source — edit 'as you type' over one RichTextBox so caret, selection and copy span rendered blocks alike. In the editor tab a double-click enters edit on a block (single click only places the caret / selects a diagram).

markdown-block-model.title: Block model + edit keys
markdown-block-model.description: Document is a list of blocks split on blank lines (fenced code/diagram stays whole). Enter splits a block, Ctrl+Enter inserts a markdown hard break, Tab inserts a tab, Backspace/Delete merge across block boundaries, Up/Down cross blocks, Escape leaves edit mode.

markdown-block-undo.title: Block-level undo
markdown-block-undo.description: Ctrl+Z restores a snapshot of the block model taken at the start of each block's editing session — edits within one block coalesce into a single undo step (block-level, not per-keystroke), up to 200 steps.

markdown-scroll-anchor.title: Scroll anchoring
markdown-scroll-anchor.description: Keeps the focal block visually fixed across document rebuilds (so entering/leaving edit or content changing elsewhere doesn't bounce the reader) and keeps the caret on screen while typing.

markdown-heading-scroll.title: Scroll-to-heading deep link
markdown-heading-scroll.description: When the tab is opened from a snaplink carrying a '>'-joined heading path, it scrolls that heading to the top after layout — matched on the full heading hierarchy so duplicate names under different parents stay distinct.

markdown-source-box.title: Source-only editor
markdown-source-box.description: Alternate surface (Source toggle on): the whole document as raw monospace markdown in one plain text box with wrapping and scroll. Edits carry across to the inline editor via the shared Markdown binding.

markdown-format-toolbar.title: Formatting mini-toolbar
markdown-format-toolbar.description: Icons-only popup shown on right-click while a block is being edited: clipboard (cut/copy/paste), headings (H1/H2/H3), inline formatting, and block formatting. Applies the action to the active block.

markdown-fmt-headings.title: Heading buttons (H1/H2/H3)
markdown-fmt-headings.description: Set the active block's first line to a heading of the chosen level, or toggle it off when already that level.

markdown-fmt-inline.title: Inline formatting (bold/italic/strike/code)
markdown-fmt-inline.description: Wrap the selection (or insert paired markers at the caret) for bold (**), italic (*), strikethrough (~~) and inline code (`). Bold/italic also reachable via WPF's Ctrl+B / Ctrl+I.

markdown-fmt-quote.title: Quote button
markdown-fmt-quote.description: Adds a '> ' prefix to every line of the active block, or strips it when every line already has it (toggle).

markdown-fmt-codeblock.title: Code-block button
markdown-fmt-codeblock.description: Wraps the active block in a ``` fence, or unwraps it when already fenced (toggle).

markdown-context-menu.title: Render-mode context menu
markdown-context-menu.description: Right-click when NOT editing a block: a themed Cut / Copy / Paste / Select All menu that preserves the selection and doesn't drop into edit mode.

markdown-copy.title: Copy as markdown
markdown-copy.description: Copies the selection (or the whole note) to the clipboard in three formats — plain text, HTML, and raw markdown — slicing the markdown source from the selection via per-run source spans so partial cross-block selections copy just the selected text.

markdown-paste.title: Paste (HTML to markdown)
markdown-paste.description: Paste prefers a custom Markdown clipboard format, else converts pasted HTML (headings, emphasis, links, images, lists, code, quotes, tables) to markdown, else plain text. A single block edits in place; a multi-block paste becomes multiple blocks.

markdown-dragdrop.title: Drag and drop
markdown-dragdrop.description: Drop content (files / images / text) onto the editor to insert it as new block(s) at the drop point; a copy-only drag-out lets you drag a selection to other apps without mutating the document.

markdown-dirty-tracking.title: Dirty tracking
markdown-dirty-tracking.description: Compares the live document against the last-saved baseline to drive the Save button's enabled state and surfaces an '(unsaved changes)' note in the AI context.

markdown-ai-context.title: AI context
markdown-ai-context.description: Exposes the open file (name, path, dirty flag) and a FileSystemContext rooted at its folder so the AI assistant can act on the document.

video-surface.title: Video Surface
video-surface.description: The picture area: a plain WPF Image fed per-frame from a WriteableBitmap (VlcVideoSink) — no native window, so overlays and fullscreen are ordinary WPF. Clicking anywhere on the picture toggles play/pause.

video-poster.title: Poster & Big Play Button
video-poster.description: Before first play, a first-keyframe still (poster) covers the surface and a large centre ▶ affordance invites playback; both clear once playback has started.

video-states.title: Loading / Error States
video-states.description: A 'Loading…' placeholder shows while the engine builds and parses on a background thread; an inline error card shows the failure text, and a fatal engine error closes the tab with a shell notification.

video-transport.title: Transport Bar
video-transport.description: The shared bottom control bar (same template in the tab and the fullscreen window): play/pause, step, scrubber + time, volume/mute, speed, subtitles, and the panel/strip/fullscreen toggles.

video-playpause.title: Play / Pause
video-playpause.description: Toggles playback (also bound to clicking the picture and the centre play button); resumes a paused stream or starts/restarts an ended one.

video-step.title: Skip Back / Forward
video-step.description: ⏪ / ⏩ jump playback by 5 seconds backward or forward.

video-scrubber.title: Scrubber & Time
video-scrubber.description: Seekable timeline slider with current-position and total-duration labels; dragging seeks the player and live playback echoes back into the slider (guarded against feedback).

video-volume.title: Volume & Mute
video-volume.description: 🔊/🔇 mute toggle plus a 0–100 volume slider; volume is re-asserted on play since libVLC builds the audio output only once playback starts.

video-speed.title: Playback Speed
video-speed.description: A pop-up menu offering 1×, 1.25×, 1.5× and 2× playback rates; the current rate shows on the button.

video-subtitles.title: Subtitles (CC)
video-subtitles.description: A CC pop-up listing the file's text/subtitle tracks plus 'Off'; only shown when the file carries subtitle tracks.

video-infopanel.title: Media Info Panel
video-infopanel.description: ⓘ toggles a right-hand panel listing per-track codec/metadata sections — File (name, container, size, duration), Video (codec, resolution, frame rate, bitrate), Audio (codec, channels, sample rate, language) and Subtitles — read from the parsed media.

video-scenestrip.title: Scene Strip (Keyframes)
video-scenestrip.description: 🎞 toggles a bottom strip of ~32 keyframe thumbnails sampled across the duration (rendered on a separate short-lived decoder); clicking a thumbnail seeks to that scene.

video-fullscreen.title: Fullscreen
video-fullscreen.description: ⛶ opens a borderless maximised top-most window bound to the same VideoFrame bitmap (no surface handover) carrying the same transport bar; Esc/close returns to the tab.

video-capture-frame.title: AI: Capture Frame
video-capture-frame.description: video_capture_frame AI tool — decodes the frame at the current playback position on a fresh decoder and hands it to the model as a PNG vision attachment so it can answer 'what's on screen?'. Read-only, auto-runs.

video-hwdecode-config.title: Hardware Decoding Setting
video-hwdecode-config.description: Global Video setting (off by default) to enable hardware-accelerated decoding for newly opened videos; turn off if playback is unstable.

model3d-viewport.title: Viewport
model3d-viewport.description: The HelixViewport3D 3D scene showing the loaded geometry with default lights, a view cube and a coordinate-system gizmo; an error overlay shows in place when a model fails to load.

model3d-navigate.title: Rotate / Zoom / Pan
model3d-navigate.description: Mouse camera navigation provided by the Helix viewport — drag to rotate (turntable), wheel to zoom, middle/right-drag to pan; the view cube and coordinate gizmo give orientation cues.

model3d-turn-gesture.title: Alt+Right-Drag Turn
model3d-turn-gesture.description: An Alt + right-drag gesture orbits the model about the world-up (green/Y) axis — the rotation the Z-up turntable doesn't expose, e.g. turning a side-on object to show its front or back.

model3d-toolbar.title: Toolbar
model3d-toolbar.description: Top toolbar with the Wireframe toggle, the Reset view button, the turn-gesture hint, and (right) the Inspector toggle.

model3d-wireframe.title: Wireframe Toggle
model3d-wireframe.description: Switches the model between solid shading and an edges-only wireframe, built on demand from the mesh triangles; also driven by the AI set_render_mode tool.

model3d-reset.title: Reset View
model3d-reset.description: Re-frames the model to the viewport — restoring the on-load camera (the file's authored view, or the initial bounding-box framing).

model3d-stats-footer.title: Stats Footer
model3d-stats-footer.description: A footer strip reporting the detected format, triangle/vertex/mesh counts and the file size for the loaded model.

model3d-inspector.title: Material Inspector
model3d-inspector.description: A right-hand slide-out panel listing the model's materials (name, colour swatch, hex + texture detail) and a 'Declared but not rendered' list (animations, cameras, lights, skeletal rigs). Toggled from the toolbar; opens by default when there's content.

model3d-loaders.title: Loader Format Coverage
model3d-loaders.description: Format dispatch via ModelLoaderRegistry: HelixToolkit (STL/OBJ/3DS/PLY), SharpGLTF (glTF/glb, including the authored camera), and a catch-all Assimp loader for FBX/3MF/AMF/Collada/Blender/X and many more; meshes + diffuse materials are mapped, non-mesh content reported as unsupported.

model3d-ai-tools.title: AI Viewport Tools
model3d-ai-tools.description: Eight read-only AI tools driving the live viewport: capture_viewport_image, get_model_info, orbit_model, roll_model, zoom_model, pan_model, reset_view and set_render_mode — camera moves and capture are fulfilled by delegates the view wires onto the view-model.

notebook-cells.title: Cell List
notebook-cells.description: The notebook's cells rendered in document order in a scrolling list; a template selector builds only the markdown or the code control per cell so nothing is wasted. Cell source (string or array of line-strings) is decoded and joined from the nbformat JSON.

notebook-markdown-cell.title: Markdown Cell
notebook-markdown-cell.description: A markdown cell rendered as formatted markdown (via the shared SelectableMarkdownView) with no editor chrome — wide diagrams scroll horizontally.

notebook-code-cell.title: Code Cell
notebook-code-cell.description: A code cell shown in a bordered card: an In[n]/In[ ] execution-count gutter label plus the source syntax-highlighted (CodeBlockView) for the kernel's tree-sitter grammar, scrolling horizontally as needed.

notebook-kernel-grammar.title: Kernel Language Detection
notebook-kernel-grammar.description: Reads the kernel language from metadata.kernelspec / language_info and maps it to a tree-sitter grammar id (python/ruby/javascript/typescript/c-sharp, defaulting to python) so code cells highlight in the right language.

notebook-outline.title: Code Outline
notebook-outline.description: A right-hand panel listing each code cell's declared types and top-level functions (from CodeStructureExtractor), rendered as markdown; shown only when there's structure to display.

process-columns.title: Sortable Columns
process-columns.description: Click any column header (Name, CPU, Private, Memory, PID, Description, Company) to sort; clicking again toggles direction. Defaults to CPU descending; sort glyph and accent mark the active column. Columns are width-resizable by dragging the header edge.

system-gauges.title: System CPU / RAM Gauges
system-gauges.description: Header strip showing live system-wide CPU and memory load as sparkline charts (60-sample history) plus a current-percent readout, alongside shown/total process counts.

process-toolbar.title: View Controls
process-toolbar.description: The toolbar row above the list: search box, tree toggle, expand/collapse-all, the live/pause toggle and refresh-now button.

process-row-menu.title: Row Context Menu
process-row-menu.description: Right-click menu on a process row: View details, Open file location, Copy name/PID/path/details, and the destructive Kill process / Kill process tree (confirmation-gated).

kill-process.title: Kill Process / Tree
kill-process.description: Terminates a process (or, in tree mode, the process and every child it started) after a confirmation dialog. Tries non-elevated first and escalates through the privilege bridge (one UAC) on access denial.

open-file-location.title: Open File Location
open-file-location.description: Opens the process image's folder in a File Explorer tab; falls back to reading the image path on demand when the row's path is blank.

copy-process-info.title: Copy Name / PID / Path / Details
copy-process-info.description: Clipboard helpers from the row menu: copy the process name, PID, full image path, or a multi-line details block (name, CPU, private/working-set bytes, description, company, path).

set-priority.title: Set Priority
set-priority.description: Changes the process's priority class (Idle / BelowNormal / Normal / AboveNormal / High / RealTime) from the General tab's combo box; escalates through the privilege bridge (one UAC) on access denial.

process-elevation.title: Privilege Escalation
process-elevation.description: Cross-cutting elevation path: kill, set-priority and handle/module inspect each try non-elevated first and, on access denial, escalate through the IShellServices privilege bridge — one UAC prompt — surfacing declined/failed outcomes back to the user.

process-ai-tools.title: AI Process Tools
process-ai-tools.description: The client tools the page exposes to the AI: read-only list_processes, get_top_consumers, get_process_details, get_process_modules, get_process_tree, plus the approval-gated kill_process and set_process_priority. The page also feeds a live process summary as AI context (high security risk).

scratchpad-toolbar.title: Toolbar
scratchpad-toolbar.description: Top toolbar strip: New note and Zoom-to-Fit on the left, the Recycle Bin split button on the right.

toolbar-new-note.title: New
toolbar-new-note.description: '＋ New' toolbar button — drops a fresh empty post-it at the viewport centre, opened ready to type.

toolbar-zoom-fit.title: Zoom to Fit
toolbar-zoom-fit.description: '⤡ Fit' toolbar button — rescales and recentres the view so every note fits with padding (clamped 0.1–4×).

toolbar-recycle-toggle.title: Recycle Bin Button
toolbar-recycle-toggle.description: Split button: the left part toggles the recycle-bin panel (accent-highlighted while open); the ▾ dropdown opens a menu with Empty Recycle Bin.

canvas-context-menu.title: Canvas Context Menu
canvas-context-menu.description: Right-clicking empty canvas offers 'New post-it here' (placed at the cursor) and 'Paste as post-it' (enabled only when the clipboard holds text/image/files), classifying the paste the same way as a drop.

scratchpad-pan-zoom.title: Pan & Zoom
scratchpad-pan-zoom.description: Navigate the infinite canvas: middle-drag (or left-drag on empty space) pans; mouse-wheel zooms at the cursor; Ctrl +/-/0 zoom in/out/reset; a status-bar zoom % label opens a 50–150% preset picker. Scale is clamped 0.08–4×.

pan-canvas.title: Pan
pan-canvas.description: Middle-button drag pans immediately; left-button drag on empty space arms a pan that begins once the pointer moves (so a plain click still selects), updating the translate transform and minimap.

wheel-zoom.title: Mouse-wheel Zoom
wheel-zoom.description: Scrolling zooms about the cursor (×1.1 per notch), keeping the point under the pointer fixed; also bound to Ctrl +/- and Ctrl+0 (reset to 100%).

zoom-preset-picker.title: Zoom % Picker
zoom-preset-picker.description: Status-bar zoom percentage label; clicking it opens a popup of 50/75/100/125/150% presets that set the zoom about the viewport centre.

postit-note.title: Post-it Note
postit-note.description: The board's primary object: a draggable, resizable, rotatable sticky card with an inline-markdown body, a header (rotate handle, drag area, timer badge, close), a chosen colour and shape, persisted to disk and debounce-saved on edit.

postit-editor.title: Inline Markdown Editor
postit-editor.description: The note body is a single inline-markdown surface — the caret's block shows source while the rest renders, with native caret/selection/copy across the whole note. A fresh empty note opens in edit mode; legacy RichTextBox-XAML notes migrate to plain text on first load.

postit-drag-move.title: Drag to Move
postit-drag-move.description: Dragging the note header (or bottom grip) moves it across the canvas in canvas coordinates and brings it to the front.

postit-resize.title: Resize Handles
postit-resize.description: Eight invisible edge/corner grips resize the note (min 80px), solved in the note's local axes so a rotated note resizes correctly and the un-dragged corner stays pinned.

postit-rotate.title: Rotate Handle
postit-rotate.description: A small ↻ handle at the header's left edge rotates the note about its centre; new notes also start at a slight random tilt (±8°).

postit-pin-timer.title: Pin / Expiry Timer
postit-pin-timer.description: Each note shows a timer badge counting down its remaining lifetime; clicking it toggles pinned (📌, never expires) vs counting down. Unpinned notes auto-move to the recycle bin when the timer runs out.

postit-close.title: Remove Note
postit-close.description: The header ✕ button removes the note from the board (it goes to the recycle bin rather than being destroyed).

postit-zorder.title: Z-order (Front / Back)
postit-zorder.description: Bring-to-front / send-to-back ordering: notes raise to the top when dragged/resized, and the mini-ribbon's Front/Back buttons restack a note explicitly.

postit-mini-ribbon.title: Note Mini-ribbon
postit-mini-ribbon.description: Right-clicking a note header opens a popup ribbon (rendered above any transform so it's never rotated) for changing the note's colour and shape and restacking it front/back.

postit-colors.title: Colours
postit-colors.description: Seven pastel paper colours — Yellow, Blue, Green, Pink, Orange, Purple, White — picked from the mini-ribbon colour dots; each maps to a themed two-tone fill + header strip.

postit-content-types.title: Content Types
postit-content-types.description: The kinds of note the drop/paste classifier produces — image, file/folder link, URL preview, plain markdown — created either as new notes (on the canvas) or inserted as blocks into an existing note.

note-image.title: Image Note
note-image.description: Dropping/pasting an image file (or a raw browser bitmap) copies/encodes it into the note's attachment folder and embeds it via ![](name); a new image note auto-sizes to the picture's aspect (capped).

note-file-link.title: File / Folder Link Note
note-file-link.description: A non-image file or folder becomes a clickable 📄/📁 markdown link; clicking it routes through the shell so a feature can open it (falling back to the OS).

note-url-preview.title: URL Preview Note
note-url-preview.description: A bare http(s) URL shows immediately as the link, then a background task fetches Open Graph / HTML metadata (title, description, downloaded preview image) and swaps in a rich preview card; image URLs embed directly. Downloaded media lives in the note's attachment folder so it works offline.

note-text.title: Text / Markdown Note
note-text.description: Dropped/pasted plain text or markdown becomes a note (or an inserted block) as-is, choosing the best markdown flavour available on the clipboard.

note-attachments.title: Note Attachments
note-attachments.description: Each note owns a per-id attachment folder holding its dropped images and downloaded preview media; the folder follows the note's lifetime (survives recycle/restore, removed only on permanent delete) and is the BaseDirectory for resolving relative image paths.

scratchpad-config.title: Settings
scratchpad-config.description: Options-page settings: New Note Lifetime (30 min–24 h, drives the expiry countdown) and Recycle Bin Retention (None–Infinite, drives the startup purge).

scratchpad-ai-tools.title: AI Tools
scratchpad-ai-tools.description: AI client tools that let the assistant work the board: list notes (with colour/shape filters), read full note content, and add a note — plus the tab's AI context (per-colour note count) and system-prompt guidance.

ai-list-notes.title: List Notes Tool
ai-list-notes.description: scratchpad_list_notes — lists each note's id, colour, shape, pin/time-left, position+size and a one-line preview, optionally filtered by colour and/or shape.

ai-read-notes.title: Read Notes Tool
ai-read-notes.description: scratchpad_read_notes — returns the full markdown of notes filtered by id, colour and/or shape (so 'read the green notes' maps to a colour filter).

ai-add-note.title: Add Note Tool
ai-add-note.description: scratchpad_add_note — adds a note with the given markdown on a fixed white, diagonally-rounded card (so AI-authored notes are recognisable), placed near the viewport centre with a cascade; auto-runs without an approval prompt.

scratchpad-theming.title: PostIt Theme Tokens
scratchpad-theming.description: The scratchpad's own categorical colour bank — PostIt.<colour>.Fill/.Header for the seven papers plus the minimap viewport stroke/fill — shipped as an IThemeContribution that merges below the active theme, so every theme gets pastel defaults for free and may retune any token by name.

sysinfo-refresh.title: Refresh
sysinfo-refresh.description: Re-gathers the whole device snapshot on demand; guarded so a re-scan can't overlap. Shows an animated 'Gathering…' indicator while the background task runs.

sysinfo-context.title: AI Device Context
sysinfo-context.description: Exposes the latest snapshot as a flat plain-text 'Device summary for <machine>' so the dashboard can be attached to an AI conversation as context. Offered in the AI 'add context' menu (CanBeContextItem).

sysinfo-statuscolour.title: Health Colour Coding
sysinfo-statuscolour.description: Per-fact advisory status (Neutral/Good/Warning/Bad) maps each value's text colour to a theme brush (Text/Success/Warning/Danger) so the dashboard's health cues track the active theme rather than using hard-coded colours.

sysinfo-wmi.title: WMI Probe Layer
sysinfo-wmi.description: Fault-tolerant wrapper over WMI/CIM queries underpinning the dashboard, services and security probes: arbitrary-scope WQL, typed property readers, uint[] security-property sets and CIM_DATETIME parsing — every helper swallows failures so a missing class never blanks the whole snapshot.

sysinfo-services.title: Services Page
sysinfo-services.description: Standalone Windows Services tab (own page kind 'SystemServices'): a virtualized, sortable, filterable grid of every Win32_Service with per-row Start/Stop/Restart/Pause/Resume controls and a startup-type picker that route through the elevated privilege bridge. Background-loaded and disposed when the tab closes; offered to the AI 'add context' menu.

sysinfo-services-grid.title: Service List & Filter
sysinfo-services-grid.description: Virtualized DataGrid of services (display name, key name, status, startup type, actions) sorted by display name, with a live text filter matching name or display name and a coloured status cell. Read off the UI thread from Win32_Service.

sysinfo-services-refresh.title: Services Refresh
sysinfo-services-refresh.description: Re-scans all services off the UI thread (cancellable; cancelled on tab close). After an elevated action, only the affected row's live status + startup mode are re-read in place rather than a full re-scan.

sysinfo-services-control.title: Start / Stop / Restart / Pause / Resume
sysinfo-services-control.description: Per-row service control buttons, enabled by the row's live state (e.g. Start only when stopped, Pause only when running and AcceptPause). Each runs the matching elevated op through the bridge (one UAC prompt) and refreshes the row; errors are surfaced unless the user declined.

sysinfo-services-startmode.title: Startup Type Picker
sysinfo-services-startmode.description: Per-row ComboBox to set Automatic / Automatic (Delayed) / Manual / Disabled. A genuine pick routes through the elevated bridge; the box is OneWay-bound and snapped back to the real value after the write (suppressing the programmatic re-selection so it never loops). Delayed-auto is read from the service's registry key since WMI only reports 'Auto'.

sysinfo-services-tools.title: Services AI Tools
sysinfo-services-tools.description: AI client tools for the Services page: read tools (get_services, find_service, get_service) auto-run; act tools (start/stop/restart_service, set_service_start_mode) require approval and then run through the elevated bridge, so an AI-driven change is gated twice (tool approval + UAC). Exposes a running/stopped/automatic summary as conversation context.

sysinfo-envvars.title: Environment Variables Page
sysinfo-envvars.description: Standalone Environment Variables tab (page kind 'SystemEnvVars'): master/detail editor over User and Machine scopes. User edits apply in-process (no UAC); Machine edits route through the elevated bridge (UAC). Background-loaded, disposed on close, and offered to the AI 'add context' menu.

sysinfo-envvars-scope.title: Scope Selector & Filter
sysinfo-envvars-scope.description: Scope dropdown (User / Machine) repopulates the name list; a name-substring filter narrows it. Both scopes are gathered in one background pass and values are kept raw/unexpanded so %VAR% indirection survives a round-trip.

sysinfo-envvars-editor.title: Value Editor
sysinfo-envvars-editor.description: Roomy multiline value editor for the selected variable, read-only when nothing is selected. Edits stage in EditValue and are committed via Save.

sysinfo-envvars-pathlist.title: PATH Entry Editor
sysinfo-envvars-pathlist.description: For ';'-delimited values (PATH, PATHEXT, PSModulePath…) a per-entry list appears: add a new entry, reorder up/down, or remove an entry, with the composite value recomposed live from the entries.

sysinfo-envvars-save.title: Save Variable
sysinfo-envvars-save.description: Commits the edited value: User scope writes in-process via Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable (registry write + WM_SETTINGCHANGE broadcast, no UAC); Machine scope routes through the elevated bridge. On success the list re-loads and re-selects the variable.

sysinfo-envvars-delete.title: Delete Variable
sysinfo-envvars-delete.description: Deletes the selected variable after a confirmation dialog: User scope in-process, Machine scope via the elevated bridge.

sysinfo-envvars-add.title: Add Variable
sysinfo-envvars-add.description: Adds a new variable in the current scope: prompts for a name, then creates it with an empty value (User in-process / Machine via bridge) and selects it for editing.

sysinfo-envvars-tools.title: Environment Variables AI Tools
sysinfo-envvars-tools.description: AI client tools for the env-vars page: read tools (get_environment_variables with truncation, get_environment_variable for a full value like PATH) auto-run; set/delete require approval and then route by scope (User in-process, Machine via bridge/UAC). Surfaces a user/machine + PATH summary as conversation context.

sysinfo-elevation.title: Privilege Bridge
sysinfo-elevation.description: All mutating operations on the Services and Environment Variables pages (service control + start-mode, machine-scope env set/delete) run through the shell's elevated bridge via RunElevatedAsync — one UAC prompt per action — so the app itself stays non-elevated. Declines are handled silently; other failures show an error. Pages report a High context-security risk and a security context tag.

console-cmd-here.title: Cmd Here
console-cmd-here.description: Folder action that opens a Console tab rooted at the selected folder; if that location has no pinned environment and there's a real choice, the launch picker appears.

console-routing-group.title: Command vs AI routing
console-routing-group.description: How a typed line is split: recognised shell commands run in the terminal, natural language goes to the AI agent.

console-enter-classify.title: Enter line classification
console-enter-classify.description: At a prompt, Enter classifies the typed line: a command runs (recorded in history); natural language is wiped off the shell line and handed to the LLM. Mid-program, Enter is forwarded for interactive input.

console-gt-prefix.title: '>' prefix to terminal
console-gt-prefix.description: Query handler routing: a '>'-prefixed line (or a bare line the terminal recognises as a command) typed in the AI bar runs in the active terminal instead of reaching the AI.

console-bar-history-keys.title: AI-bar history / completion keys
console-bar-history-keys.description: While the bar is empty or in '>' console mode, Up/Down step through command history (most-recent-first); a key handler forwards Up/Down/Tab to the active terminal.

console-bar-drop.title: Drop file onto AI bar
console-bar-drop.description: A file dropped onto the AI bar is converted to its quoted path(s); format-matched, so it works regardless of which tab is active.

console-panels-group.title: Side panels
console-panels-group.description: The three flanking panels of the terminal: Files / Environment sub-tabs on the left, command History on the right.

console-files-panel.title: Files panel
console-files-panel.description: Lists the current directory (files first, then folders); double-click a folder to cd into it, drag an entry onto the terminal or AI bar as a quoted path.

console-env-panel.title: Environment panel
console-env-panel.description: Live process environment snapshot with a filter box and a per-row Copy / Edit context menu; refreshes when the directory changes.

console-env-edit-overlay.title: Env-var add/edit overlay
console-env-edit-overlay.description: Modal to add or edit a variable (name read-only when editing) with an Apply-to scope selector — Session (live `set`), User (persistent), or Machine (elevated, approval-gated).

console-history-panel.title: History panel
console-history-panel.description: Most-recent-first list of run commands; click an entry to re-run it.

console-copy-paste.title: Copy / Paste terminal menu
console-copy-paste.description: Terminal-surface right-click menu: Copy the selection, or Paste (drops clipboard text into the AI bar to run or edit). Ctrl-C interrupts the running program.

console-environments-group.title: Per-location environments
console-environments-group.description: Named shell setups (initial command + variable overrides + tab title) and per-folder bindings that remember which environment a location launches with.

console-env-editor.title: Environments config editor
console-env-editor.description: Master/detail editor in the workspace Configure overlay: environment list (+ Add / ✕ Remove) with a detail form (name, tab title, initial command + browse, NAME=value overrides), plus a collapsible 'default environment by location' bindings list.

console-launch-picker.title: Launch environment picker
console-launch-picker.description: On 'Cmd here' for a location with no pinned environment and >1 configured, a modal asks which environment to use, with 'Always use this environment for this location' to pin it.

console-configure-button.title: Configure button
console-configure-button.description: Top-bar deep link that opens the workspace Configure overlay on this shell's console-environments section (hidden when no configurable environments exist).

console-ai-group.title: AI integration
console-ai-group.description: The console as an AI agent surface: an inline response banner, output capture back to the model, and the run_command tool.

console-ai-banner.title: Inline AI banner
console-ai-banner.description: A dissolvable response banner hosted under the console column; any real typing, special key, or Ctrl-C dismisses it (EngagementInvalidated).

console-run-command-tool.title: run_command tool + capture
console-run-command-tool.description: Approval-gated AI tool that runs a command in the live shell and returns the captured output (plain / VT screen / classified); a process that doesn't settle is handed to a background watcher that reports back when it finishes.

console-bg-watcher.title: Background command watcher
