console-bg-watcher.description: Watches a command that hasn't returned to a prompt, backing off as it idles, and runs a continuation AI turn (with an Open-tab notification) when it finishes or starts waiting for input.

projects-list.title: Project list
projects-list.description: Bucketed project list (Projects / Shelf / Archives tabs) over each configured root; each row shows the name, a description preview and a backlog item count. Refresh reloads from disk.

projects-summary-pane.title: Project summary pane
projects-summary-pane.description: Right-column preview of the selected project: title, last-modified, the backlog status breakdown (a generated Mermaid pie) prepended to the read-only markdown description, and Open Project / Open Files plus the bucket action (Archive and Shelf, or Reactivate).

projects-detail.title: Project detail tab
projects-detail.description: Tabbed project page (Project Details / Backlog), opening on Backlog when a description exists else on Project Details; hosts the markdown description, completion criteria and the backlog editor.

projects-edit-fields.title: Description & completion criteria
projects-edit-fields.description: Markdown Description (inline editor, auto-saved) and a Completion criteria list, each criterion carrying a should / shouldn't / done / faulted status. Scope was removed and the old objectives became criteria.

projects-backlog-group.title: Backlog
projects-backlog-group.description: The backlog board of a project: a list of items with a status pip + label, an add box, an item editor, and the 9-state progression workflow.

projects-backlog-states.title: Configurable statuses
projects-backlog-states.description: Per-workspace configurable backlog statuses (label + swatch colour), stored by name so reordering never moves an item and deleting a status leaves items on it invalid rather than remapped. Defaults to the former nine states.

projects-backlog-add.title: Add backlog item
projects-backlog-add.description: New-todo box (+ Add / Enter) that appends an item at NotStarted and clears the input.

projects-backlog-progress.title: Progress item
projects-backlog-progress.description: Progress steps an item forward through the configured order (stopping at the last non-terminal); a themed dropdown sets it to any configured status directly.

projects-backlog-editor.title: Backlog item editor
projects-backlog-editor.description: Right-pane editor: a themed status dropdown + Progress, Title, a single markdown Description (replacing the Notes / Implementation Plan / Test Plan fields), Task to AI / Plan with AI buttons, and Save / Delete.

projects-backlog-delete.title: Delete item
projects-backlog-delete.description: Delete on the editor, confirmation-gated; removes the item from the backlog.

projects-ai-summary-viewlet.title: AI Summary viewlet
projects-ai-summary-viewlet.description: Folder-explorer viewlet showing a folder's hidden .aisummary text, with Edit / Save and an overflow '···' that expands to Large mode.

projects-config.title: Projects config
projects-config.description: Per-workspace settings via a custom Options control: an Enable toggle, three project-folder locations (active / shelf / archive), and a reorderable backlog-status editor (label + swatch colour).

projects-ai-tools.title: AI project tools
projects-ai-tools.description: Planned: the Projects tab currently exposes no AI client tools (no IClientTool / GetClientTools); ProjectOperations is an internal contract only.

product-node-menu.title: Node context menu
product-node-menu.description: Right-click an arc for: Add child / Add root, Rename…, Delete…, Promote / Demote, Insert parent above…, and a Status cascade (should / shouldn't / done / faulted).

product-version-bar.title: Version bar
product-version-bar.description: Combo to switch between Current and saved snapshots, plus a ⋮ menu: Take snapshot, Delete snapshot, Restructure…, Settings… (snapshots are read-only).

product-restructure.title: Restructure overlay
product-restructure.description: Drag-and-drop tree to re-parent nodes (drop on the product or empty space makes a node top-level); cycle-guarded reparenting, with a per-node Delete.

product-settings.title: Settings overlay
product-settings.description: Edit the export folder and the concern vocabulary (each concern with an 'auto-add to new nodes' default toggle and a remove).

product-detail-pane.title: Node detail pane
product-detail-pane.description: Right pane for the focused node: header + stacked status bar with a shipping caption, a Needs-Attention list, concern boxes, and an editable Properties block.

product-properties.title: Node properties
product-properties.description: Editable Title, a cyclable status pill (with a 'derived' marker when rolled up), Description and Note (rationale/repro) fields, plus a node-snaplink count + attach affordance.

product-needs-attention.title: Needs-attention list
product-needs-attention.description: A red 'NEEDS YOUR ATTENTION' section listing faulted leaves / faulted-concern nodes with their note; clicking a row navigates to that node.

product-status-rollup.title: Status roll-up
product-status-rollup.description: Effective-status aggregation over the four states (Should / Shouldnt / Done / Faulted) with Faulted > Should > Done > Shouldn't precedence; parents roll up children's effective status plus their own concerns.

product-concerns.title: Concerns
product-concerns.description: Cross-cutting tags (e.g. tests, a11y) attached to a node as concern boxes: a cyclable status pill, remove, and a snaplinks dropdown; + concern adds one from the product's defined vocabulary.

product-snaplinks.title: Snaplinks
product-snaplinks.description: Typed links from a node or concern to a target — markdown (file + heading path), code (file + class/method/ast), or url — added via a picker, openable in a tab, removable.

product-snaplink-picker.title: Snaplink picker overlay
product-snaplink-picker.description: Add-snaplink overlay with two tabs: Link file (file tree → headings/classes/methods, + Add selected) and Link URL (text box + drop zone, Add URL); lists existing snaplinks with open/remove.

product-viewlet.title: Folder viewlet
product-viewlet.description: File-explorer side panel shown for any folder containing .product/: product name, an N-nodes · done/leaf · faulted summary, and an Open button to launch the tab.

product-create-action.title: Create .product action
product-create-action.description: Folder action that initialises a .product/ store in a folder so it can be tracked.

product-ai-tools.title: AI product tools
product-ai-tools.description: Twelve client tools: read-only survey/zoom/needs-attention and set-status/edit/add-snaplink/set-concern-status; approval-gated remove-snaplink and add/remove-concern.

aichat-browser.title: Conversation browser
aichat-browser.description: The AI Chat tab: a list of past conversations (title, start→end, message count, summary) with a date filter and a 'New conversation' button.

aichat-new.title: New conversation
aichat-new.description: Opens a fresh, empty Conversation tab (persisted only on its first exchange so blank chats don't clutter the browser).

aichat-row-actions.title: Conversation row actions
aichat-row-actions.description: Per-row Open (opens the conversation tab), Analysis (🔍 opens the analysis overlay) and Delete (✕, confirmation-gated permanent delete).

aichat-analysis-overlay.title: Analysis overlay
aichat-analysis-overlay.description: Modal showing a conversation's background analysis — summary, topic, tone/evolution, understanding, key decisions, important facts, valuable attachments — with an Open-conversation button.

aichat-conversation-view.title: Conversation view
aichat-conversation-view.description: A single conversation tab: user/assistant bubbles plus live agent activity (collapsible tool batches, inline approval prompts, the typing line) and a token-budget footer.

aichat-approvals.title: Inline tool approvals
aichat-approvals.description: Accept / Deny prompts rendered inline in the thread for approval-gated tool batches and plans, replaced by an ✓ Approved / ✕ Declined outcome once resolved.

aichat-interjections.title: Mid-turn interjections
aichat-interjections.description: Messages typed while the agent is working are queued as faint 'pending' chips and delivered at the next turn boundary.

aichat-context-pinning.title: Context pinning
aichat-context-pinning.description: A 'Context Items' banner where tabs/files are dragged to pin them as context: per-item chips with a security-risk badge and remove, attachments with a missing-file marker; the conversation exposes the union of pinned pages' AI tools.

aichat-history-resume.title: History & resume
aichat-history-resume.description: Conversations persist to disk and reload on open; on resume a prior analysis stands in for the messages it covers, and history is budgeted to 75% of the model's context window.

aichat-config.title: AI Chat config
aichat-config.description: Feature settings: a toggle for automatic conversation analysis and a retention period (1 week → forever); older conversations are purged when the tab opens.

web-toolbar.title: Navigation toolbar
web-toolbar.description: Top toolbar: Back / Forward, a (read-only, trimmed) URL bar, Reload, and an 'open in your default browser' button.

web-breadcrumbs.title: Title & breadcrumbs
web-breadcrumbs.description: Tab title and a file-path-style breadcrumb derived from the live URL (host crumb + one per path segment, each navigable) and page title.

web-fallback.title: Missing-runtime fallback
web-fallback.description: When the embedded WebView2 can't start, the tab swaps to a panel that explains why, offers to open the page in the default browser, and (if the Edge runtime is missing) links to install it.

web-ai-context.title: AI page context
web-ai-context.description: Read-only AI tools to see the live page: capture_web_page (screenshot + how much of the page is visible) and scroll_web_page (scroll a viewport-fraction and re-capture).

web-airspace.title: Overlay airspace handling
web-airspace.description: Hides the WebView2's native HWND while a shell overlay (AI response, Options) covers the page, so the overlay isn't drawn behind it.

web-browse-action.title: Browse file action
web-browse-action.description: File action ('Browse') that opens .html/.htm/.url files in a Web tab.

web-url-pin.title: Pin URL to ribbon / open URL object
web-url-pin.description: Drag a link from a browser onto the ribbon to pin it as an open-in-Web button; routes a clicked URL object (e.g. from the scratchpad) into a Web tab.

tabular-open-action.title: Open As Table
tabular-open-action.description: File-list action 'As Table' (▦) opens a CSV/TSV/fixed-width file in the Tabular viewer tab.

tabular-detection.title: Reading & shape detection
tabular-detection.description: How a tabular file is read into a grid: detect the shape (separator, quote, header, column types, encoding/line-endings, fixed-width vs single-column, with AI disambiguation when ambiguous) and tokenize each line into cells.

tabular-fixed-width.title: Fixed-width fallback
tabular-fixed-width.description: When no separator scores well, detects column boundaries as character positions that are blank in every row and slices rows into fixed-width columns.

tabular-single-column.title: Single-column fallback
tabular-single-column.description: Pathological/unstructured files always render as one column so the viewer never fails to open.

tabular-header-detection.title: Header detection
tabular-header-detection.description: Decides whether row 0 is a header by checking whether its cells fail to parse as the typed columns below them; a header-disguised comment line can be promoted to the header.

tabular-coltype-detection.title: Column-type detection
tabular-coltype-detection.description: Classifies each cell into the most specific type (String/Integer/Decimal/Currency/Boolean/Date/Time/DateTime) and aggregates per column; widens (only) as later windows are scrolled into view.

tabular-comment-strip.title: Comment-line stripping
tabular-comment-strip.description: Strips a leading run of '#'-prefixed comment lines from the data; an ⓘ info icon above the row index column shows exactly which lines were skipped on hover.

tabular-encoding-detect.title: Encoding & line-ending detection
tabular-encoding-detect.description: Sniffs the BOM/UTF-8 encoding and CR/LF/CRLF line ending from a byte sample; the encoding name is shown in the footer.

tabular-ai-disambiguate.title: AI shape disambiguation
tabular-ai-disambiguate.description: When two structurally-different parses score about equally, asks the Disambiguation model which interpretation fits — otherwise the detector picks confidently on its own.

tabular-windowed-load.title: Windowed loading
tabular-windowed-load.description: Large files (≥100 KB) are read through a sliding 150-row window scanned from disk on each scroll; small files load whole into memory. A synthetic scrollbar spans the full file row range.

tabular-row-count.title: Row count
tabular-row-count.description: Footer shows total rows: an immediate estimate, then a background counter that scans the file (CR/LF-aware) and grows the count to the true value.

tabular-column-resize.title: Column resize
tabular-column-resize.description: A drag thumb on the right edge of each column header resizes that column (min 40px), updating header and every row cell together.

tabular-hscroll.title: Horizontal scroll
tabular-hscroll.description: Header strip and row body scroll horizontally in lock-step via a shared scrollbar that appears only when content is wider than the viewport.

tabular-footer.title: Status footer
tabular-footer.description: Bottom bar showing file name, row count (or 'counting…'), encoding, small/large mode, and a row-counting spinner.

tabular-breadcrumb.title: Path breadcrumb
tabular-breadcrumb.description: The tab's 'folder › file.csv' breadcrumb; clicking a folder crumb opens a file-explorer tab rooted there.

tabular-column-actions.title: Column actions
tabular-column-actions.description: Right-click a column header for a context menu of reshaping actions (rename, merge, split, evaluate-as); these record reversible transforms on the data shape.

tabular-column-select.title: Select column
tabular-column-select.description: Left-clicking a header selects the column (Ctrl/Shift to add), tinting it and opening the filter side panel for it.

tabular-rename-column.title: Rename column
tabular-rename-column.description: 'Rename column…' opens a shell prompt; the new name is stored as a transform so it survives re-derivation and ribbon pinning.

tabular-merge-prev.title: Merge with previous
tabular-merge-prev.description: Treats the boundary between this column and the one to its left as data, rejoining the cells on the original separator (split-then-merge round-trips cleanly).

tabular-split-by.title: Split by
tabular-split-by.description: 'Split by ▶' submenu splits a column on a literal character (tab/comma/pipe/space/etc.) into N cells; separators not present in the column's sample are shown disabled.

tabular-evaluate-as.title: Evaluate as
tabular-evaluate-as.description: 'Evaluate as ▶' reclassifies a column's type (with type glyphs); only types whose parser succeeds on every sample value are enabled (String always available). Drives sort/filter behavior.

tabular-sort.title: Column sort
tabular-sort.description: In small mode, the header sort glyph cycles asc → desc → none, sorting the in-memory rows by the column's typed value (numeric/date/currency/text comparers). Disabled (glyph blank) in large windowed mode.

tabular-filter.title: Filter panel
tabular-filter.description: Right-side slide-out (opens automatically when columns are selected) with a typed filter editor per selected column; rows are filtered as you type, AND-ed across columns. Exposed to the AI via an open_filter tool.

tabular-filter-string.title: Text filter
tabular-filter-string.description: Substring (case-insensitive) text filter for String columns, with an optional regex mode.

tabular-filter-numeric.title: Numeric range filter
tabular-filter-numeric.description: Min/Max range filter for Integer/Decimal/Currency columns (strips currency symbols before comparing).

tabular-filter-date.title: Date range filter
tabular-filter-date.description: From/To date pickers plus optional HH:mm:ss time boxes for Date/Time/DateTime columns.

tabular-filter-boolean.title: Boolean filter
tabular-filter-boolean.description: true/false checkboxes for Boolean columns (recognizing true/false, yes/no, y/n, 1/0).

tabular-row-select.title: Row selection
tabular-row-select.description: Excel-style row selection: click to select one, Ctrl-click to toggle, Shift-click to extend a range; selected rows seed the AI context sample.

tabular-templates.title: Templates
tabular-templates.description: Save a reshaping (split/merge/rename/type chain) as a named, reusable template and re-apply it to other files of the same shape — by hand or auto-applied on open.

tabular-template-this.title: Template This
tabular-template-this.description: Toolbar popup that saves the current column layout as a template, choosing scope: this folder, a filename glob, or manual-only.

tabular-apply-template.title: Apply Template panel
tabular-apply-template.description: Toolbar-toggled side panel listing saved templates (with a 'show only compatible' switch and per-row delete); applying one replaces the live transform chain. Confirms before applying an incompatible template.

tabular-template-autoapply.title: Auto-apply on open
tabular-template-autoapply.description: On open, a Folder/Glob-scoped template whose shape matches is applied silently; when several match, the panel forces a choice (choose mode).

tabular-template-editor.title: Templates options editor
tabular-template-editor.description: Options → Tabular Templates page lists every saved template for rename/delete (deletions apply on Save).

tabular-ribbon-pin.title: Ribbon pin (with reshaping)
tabular-ribbon-pin.description: Pinning a Tabular tab to the ribbon captures the file path AND the live transform chain, so re-opening restores every merge/split/rename/type the user had applied.

tabular-ai.title: AI integration
tabular-ai.description: Feeds the AI a context summary (shape, columns + types, selected/visible row sample) and exposes view-control tools so the assistant can navigate the grid.

tabular-ai-tools.title: AI grid tools
tabular-ai-tools.description: AI client tools to drive the view: open the filter panel, scroll to top, scroll to end.

text-viewer-toolbar.title: Toolbar
text-viewer-toolbar.description: Top toolbar of the text viewer: encoding selector, display toggles, clipboard, monitor, split.

text-viewer-editor.title: Text View
text-viewer-editor.description: Read-only AvalonEdit pane that displays the file with monospace font, line numbers, caret tracking and context-menu cut/copy/paste.

text-viewer-windowing.title: Head-First Windowing
text-viewer-windowing.description: Large files (>=100 KB) stream head-first in 100 KB chunks with a pre-scanned line index and placeholder padding so the scrollbar is full-size; more loads as the viewport advances.

text-viewer-streaming-indicator.title: Streaming Indicator
text-viewer-streaming-indicator.description: Status-bar 'Streaming' badge shown while a large file is being windowed.

text-viewer-encoding.title: Encoding Selector
text-viewer-encoding.description: Dropdown to re-read the file as UTF-8, UTF-16 LE/BE, Latin-1 or system default; changing it reloads the file.

text-viewer-linenumbers.title: Line Numbers Toggle
text-viewer-linenumbers.description: Toggle button that shows or hides the AvalonEdit line-number margin.

text-viewer-wordwrap.title: Word Wrap Toggle
text-viewer-wordwrap.description: Toggle button that enables or disables soft word wrapping in the editor.

text-viewer-clipboard.title: Cut / Copy / Paste
text-viewer-clipboard.description: Toolbar buttons (and context menu) delegating to AvalonEdit's ApplicationCommands for clipboard actions.

text-viewer-monitor.title: File Monitor Toggle
text-viewer-monitor.description: Watches the file via the shell watcher and reloads on change, showing a 'File changed' banner; the button toggles monitoring on/off.

text-viewer-split.title: Split File
text-viewer-split.description: Panel to split a too-large file into smaller editable files by line count, size (MB), or a boundary regex; runs as a background task.

text-viewer-find.title: Find
text-viewer-find.description: Streaming search over the whole file (plain-text or /regex/) driven from the AI input bar; shows a centred search indicator with match count and prev/next navigation, plus go-to-line scroll centring.

text-viewer-find-nav.title: Find Next / Previous
text-viewer-find-nav.description: Buttons (and F3 / Shift+F3) that jump caret-relative to the next/previous matching line, loading more file content as needed to reach it.

text-viewer-minimap.title: Match Minimap
text-viewer-minimap.description: Right-edge strip that marks the relative positions of all search matches across the full file for at-a-glance navigation.

text-viewer-ai-tools.title: AI Tools
text-viewer-ai-tools.description: Client tools exposed to the assistant: copy_visible_text and find (plain-text search).

log-viewer-toolbar.title: Toolbar
log-viewer-toolbar.description: Top toolbar of the log viewer: level highlight toggles, custom term, pause/follow, copy, encoding.

log-viewer-view.title: Log View
log-viewer-view.description: Read-only AvalonEdit pane with a clickable left margin for whole-line selection, level/filter colourising, and centred scroll-to navigation.

log-viewer-tail-streaming.title: Tail-First Streaming
log-viewer-tail-streaming.description: Large logs load the last ~4 KB first (snapped to a line start), then the head reassembles in 64 KB chunks in the background so the recent end is readable instantly.

log-viewer-watch.title: Live File Watch / Append
log-viewer-watch.description: Watches the file and appends only newly written bytes; auto-scrolls to the new tail when following.

log-viewer-level-highlight.title: Level Highlight Toggles
log-viewer-level-highlight.description: Five colour-coded toggles (FATAL/ERROR/WARN/INFO/DEBUG) that highlight matching log lines using the active parser's level detection.

log-viewer-custom-term.title: Custom Highlight Term
log-viewer-custom-term.description: Text box that highlights every case-insensitive occurrence of an arbitrary term across the loaded log.

log-viewer-pause.title: Pause / Resume
log-viewer-pause.description: Toggle that pauses auto-update from the file; appended content is buffered and flushed on resume.

log-viewer-follow.title: Follow / Auto-Scroll
log-viewer-follow.description: Toggle that auto-scrolls the view to the bottom whenever new content is appended.

log-viewer-line-select-copy.title: Line Selection & Copy
log-viewer-line-select-copy.description: Click the left margin to toggle whole-line selection (auto-copied); the Copy button copies all selected lines to the clipboard.

log-viewer-encoding.title: Encoding Selector
log-viewer-encoding.description: Dropdown to override encoding; default is sniffed via the shared EncodingDetector (BOM + UTF-8 validity + UTF-16 heuristic).

log-viewer-filter.title: Regex Filter
log-viewer-filter.description: Side-panel regex box that fades (dims) lines not matching the pattern, with a clear button.

log-viewer-time-filter.title: Time Range Filter
log-viewer-time-filter.description: From/To date+time fields (shown only when timestamps are detected) that fade out-of-range lines and scroll to the first in-range line; auto-populated from the log's first/last parseable timestamps.

log-viewer-parser.title: Format Auto-Detect
log-viewer-parser.description: Confidence-voting parser registry picks JSON-lines vs raw-text from the file header and first line; the resolved format name shows in the status bar.

json-tree.title: Tree View
json-tree.description: Default mode rendering objects/arrays/values as indented rows with type/value labels and expand toggles.

json-text-mode.title: Raw Text Mode
json-text-mode.description: Renders the selected node's raw JSON inline in an editable AvalonEdit block; edits commit back into the model on blur.

json-table-mode.title: Table Mode
json-table-mode.description: Renders an array of objects as a column-aligned table (inline DataGrid, or root-array rows in the outer list) when the selected node is a uniform array.

json-windowing.title: Seek-by-Item Windowing
json-windowing.description: Large files pre-populate virtual placeholder rows sized to an estimated item count, then load/unload depth-1 batches via a sparse byte-offset index as the viewport moves (sliding window capped at 300 nodes).

json-expand-collapse.title: Expand / Collapse
json-expand-collapse.description: Per-row toggle that expands or collapses a node's children in the flat display list.

json-path-query.title: JSONPath Query
json-path-query.description: AI-bar query box ($-prefixed) that evaluates a JSONPath expression, expands ancestors, selects and scrolls to the first match.

json-breadcrumb.title: Path Breadcrumb
json-breadcrumb.description: Tab-local breadcrumb of the selected node's ancestor chain; clicking a crumb selects and scrolls to that node.

json-format.title: Format JSON
json-format.description: Toolbar button (also an AI tool) that re-indents the whole document and rebuilds the tree.

json-edit-save.title: Edit & Save
json-edit-save.description: Drag to reorder sibling nodes and inline-edit raw JSON; the Save button (shown when modified) writes the document back, blocked if unloaded sections remain.

hex-bytes-panel.title: Hex + ASCII Panel
hex-bytes-panel.description: Custom-drawn panel showing the 8-digit address column and 16 hex bytes per row (split 8|8) with selection/cursor highlights and edited-byte colouring.

hex-windowing.title: Windowed Buffer
hex-windowing.description: Piece-table buffer with an ~8 KB sliding read window so memory stays bounded regardless of file size; only visible rows are rendered.

hex-eval-pane.title: Text Evaluation Pane
hex-eval-pane.description: Toggleable side pane (byte inspector) decoding each row's bytes with the active encoding; non-printable bytes render as a dot. Splitter-resizable.

hex-goto.title: Go To Offset
hex-goto.description: Toolbar box (Ctrl+G) that jumps the cursor to a hex (or decimal) byte offset and scrolls it into view.

hex-edit-modes.title: Edit Modes
hex-edit-modes.description: Read-only / Insert / Overwrite toggles; in editable modes typing two hex digits writes a byte, Delete/Backspace remove bytes.

hex-encoding.title: Encoding Selector
hex-encoding.description: Combo (Auto/ASCII/UTF-8/UTF-16) controlling how the evaluation pane decodes bytes; Auto sniffs the BOM.

hex-undo-redo.title: Undo / Redo
hex-undo-redo.description: Buttons (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) that step the piece-table edit history backward and forward.

hex-save.title: Save / Save As
hex-save.description: Split button that writes edits back to the file in place or to a new path picked via the shell.

hex-selection-status.title: Selection & Status Bar
hex-selection-status.description: Click/drag or keyboard to select byte ranges; status bar shows file size, current offset or selection range (hex + decimal), and the active edit mode.

git-branch-picker.title: Branch Picker
git-branch-picker.description: Branch name button with a ▾ dropdown of local branches; selecting one checks it out (LibGit2Sharp Commands.Checkout) and refreshes the bar.

git-pull.title: Pull Button
git-pull.description: Fast-forward-only pull of the current branch (builds a signature from git config); reports Already up to date / Pull complete / failure in a fading inline result line.

git-open-manager.title: Open in Git Manager
git-open-manager.description: Optional 'Open' button (shown only when a Git Manager .exe is configured in options) that launches the external git GUI on the repo folder.

git-status-line.title: Status Line
git-status-line.description: Coloured inline counts of staged / modified / untracked files plus ahead/behind arrows, or 'clean' when the working tree is empty (colours from theme Success/Warning/Muted tokens).

git-last-commit.title: Last Commit Line
git-last-commit.description: Shows the tip commit's short hash, subject and a humanised time-ago (e.g. '3h ago').

git-ai-tools.title: Git AI Tools
git-ai-tools.description: Six read-only git client tools the viewlet feeds into the folder's AI surface (IViewletAiSurface): status, log, diff, branches, show, remotes — plus a one-line repo-state context string. Mutating ops are intentionally absent.

git-tool-status.title: git_status Tool
git-tool-status.description: Read-only AI tool: current branch, ahead/behind vs upstream, and the per-file staged/modified/untracked lists.

git-tool-log.title: git_log Tool
git-tool-log.description: Read-only AI tool: recent commits (hash/author/date/subject), optionally scoped to a branch and/or path.

git-tool-diff.title: git_diff Tool
git-tool-diff.description: Read-only AI tool: unified diff of uncommitted changes (working tree or staged), optionally scoped to a path; output capped so it never floods the model.

git-tool-branches.title: git_branches Tool
git-tool-branches.description: Read-only AI tool: local and remote branches with current marked, upstream and ahead/behind.

git-tool-show.title: git_show Tool
git-tool-show.description: Read-only AI tool: a commit's metadata, full message and diff against its first parent.

git-tool-remotes.title: git_remotes Tool
git-tool-remotes.description: Read-only AI tool: the repository's configured remotes (name and URL).

dotnet-target-picker.title: Target Picker
dotnet-target-picker.description: Solution/project selector: a dropdown when the folder has several targets, a plain label when there's one. Scans the folder for .slnx/.sln/.csproj/.fsproj/.vbproj, solution-preferred.

dotnet-verbs.title: Verb Toolbar
dotnet-verbs.description: Five one-click buttons — Restore / Build / Run / Test / Clean — each shelling out to the matching dotnet command against the selected target; disabled while one is running.

dotnet-progress.title: Run Status Indicator
dotnet-progress.description: Live feedback while a verb runs: a gerund label ('Building'), animated dots, and the latest output line; settling to a transient ✓ on success or ✗ on failure (with the failure surfaced via shell error toast + notification).

dotnet-nuget-caution.title: NuGet Update Caution
dotnet-nuget-caution.description: A ⚠ 'Package updates available' badge with a per-package current→latest tooltip; backed by a daily-cached background `dotnet list package --outdated` check, re-run on target switch and after restore/build.

dotnet-ai-tools.title: .NET AI Tools
dotnet-ai-tools.description: Client tools the viewlet feeds into the folder's AI surface (IViewletAiSurface): approval-gated build/test/restore/clean verbs plus a read-only outdated-package check, with a one-line target/package context string. `run` is intentionally excluded (can launch a never-exiting app).

dotnet-tool-verbs.title: dotnet_build/test/restore/clean Tools
dotnet-tool-verbs.description: Approval-gated AI tools running build/test/restore/clean against the selected (or named) target and returning the tail of the captured output.

dotnet-tool-outdated.title: dotnet_check_outdated_packages Tool
dotnet-tool-outdated.description: Read-only AI tool listing the selected target's outdated NuGet packages with current and latest versions.

windowsapps-toolbar.title: Header Bar
windowsapps-toolbar.description: Top status row: a "Discovering…" animated indicator while the first scan runs, the loaded application count once done, and a Refresh button.

windowsapps-refresh.title: Refresh
windowsapps-refresh.description: Re-scans both sources off the UI thread via the shell's background-activity queue. Pass 1 loads names + cheap metadata and shows them immediately; pass 2 measures missing on-disk sizes and patches the rows in afterwards.

windowsapps-loading-status.title: Loading / Count Indicator
windowsapps-loading-status.description: While scanning, shows "Discovering" with animated dots; once loaded, swaps to an "N applications" count. Driven by the IsLoading flag (which also gates AI context readiness).

windowsapps-columns.title: App Columns
windowsapps-columns.description: Six grid columns describing each app — Name, Publisher, Version, Installed date, Size, Source — rendered from the InstalledAppItem display wrapper (formatted date/size text, Win32/Store source label).

windowsapps-sort.title: Column Sort
windowsapps-sort.description: Click any column header to sort the list by that key (Name/Publisher/Version/Installed/Size/Source); clicking the active column toggles ascending/descending. A ▲/▼/↕ glyph and accent colour mark the active column. Sorting runs over the live ICollectionView.

windowsapps-size-pass.title: Size Measurement Pass
windowsapps-size-pass.description: Second background pass that measures the on-disk folder size of apps whose installer didn't report one, then fills the Size cells in after the list is already visible (re-sorting if the user is sorting by size).

windowsapps-filter.title: Name Filter
windowsapps-filter.description: Filters the visible list to apps whose name contains the typed text (case-insensitive substring). Driven from the shell input bar via the WindowsApps query handler when an Installed Apps tab is active; refreshes the bound collection view live.

windowsapps-rowactions.title: Row Actions Menu
windowsapps-rowactions.description: The per-row "⋯" button opens a context menu with the actions available for that app — Open Location, Remove from list (orphans only), and Uninstall.

windowsapps-openlocation.title: Open Location
windowsapps-openlocation.description: Opens the app's install folder in a new File Explorer tab. Enabled only when an install location is recorded and exists on disk.

windowsapps-ai.title: AI Integration
windowsapps-ai.description: How the apps list feeds the assistant: selected rows (or the whole list) as conversation context, and read-only client tools to query app details.

windowsapps-ai-context.title: App List Context
windowsapps-ai-context.description: Supplies the AI with context about the apps: the multi-selected rows (name/version/publisher) when a selection exists, otherwise a capped summary of all installed app names. Gated so a send waits for the first scan to finish.

windowsapps-tool-details.title: Tool: get_application_details
windowsapps-tool-details.description: Read-only AI tool returning publisher, version, install date, size, location and source for one installed app matched by exact-or-partial name.

windowsapps-tool-list.title: Tool: list_installed_applications
windowsapps-tool-list.description: Read-only AI tool listing the names of every installed application, sorted alphabetically and ignoring the current selection and filter.

winfs-tab.title: File Explorer Tab
winfs-tab.description: The file-system browser tab: opens as 'This PC' (drive list) or rooted at a named/known folder, with a directory tree, a file list, breadcrumbs and an action strip.

winfs-thispc.title: This PC (drive list)
winfs-thispc.description: Default landing view listing every connected drive; each drive resolves its label, capacity, filesystem and HDD/SSD/USB/network/CD type on a background thread, showing a loading/unavailable badge until ready.

winfs-named-folders.title: Named-folder tab variants
winfs-named-folders.description: Dropdown/catalog offers This PC plus Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Music and Videos as ready-made tab variants resolved from Windows known-folder GUIDs.

winfs-tree.title: Directory Tree
winfs-tree.description: Left-hand collapsible folder tree with This PC / folder / drive icons; click navigates, chevron lazily expands children, the tree syncs to the current path and right-click opens the folder's context actions.

winfs-filelist.title: File List
winfs-filelist.description: Main entries grid showing Name / Type / Size / Modified columns (a Filesystem column in This PC mode), with extended multi-selection; large folders stream in off the UI thread behind a loading card.

winfs-open-entry.title: Open / Navigate Entry
winfs-open-entry.description: Double-click a folder to descend, a file to run its default action (resolved by extension/magic/perceived type), or an archive to browse it like a folder via the virtual filesystem.

winfs-column-sort.title: Column Sorting
winfs-column-sort.description: Click any sortable column header (Name / Type / Size / Modified) to sort; clicking again flips direction. Folders always group first and the active column shows an up/down glyph.

winfs-footer-filter.title: Footer Counts + Quick-Filter
winfs-footer-filter.description: Status footer shows selection count plus clickable 'N folders' / 'N files' tallies; clicking a tally filters the list to that kind and highlights it in the accent colour, clicking again clears it.

winfs-breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb / Address Bar
winfs-breadcrumb.description: Tab breadcrumb segments (This PC > Drive > Folder…) each navigate on click; the path is rebuilt and the tab title updated on every folder change.

winfs-path-query.title: Path Navigation Query (>)
winfs-path-query.description: The AI/command bar '>' query handler navigates the active file tab to a typed absolute, env-var, or relative path.

winfs-action-strip.title: File Action Strip
winfs-action-strip.description: Vertical 2-column button bank on the right that rebuilds (debounced) for the current selection: built-in file/folder actions, then registry shell verbs and user-defined external apps, with success-flash and destructive-red styling.

winfs-act-copy.title: Copy
winfs-act-copy.description: Copies the selected file(s)/folder(s) to the clipboard for later paste.

winfs-act-cut.title: Cut
winfs-act-cut.description: Marks the selected file(s)/folder(s) on the clipboard for a move on the next paste.

winfs-act-paste.title: Paste
winfs-act-paste.description: Folder action that pastes clipboard files into the current folder/drive; only shown when the clipboard holds files.

winfs-act-rename.title: Rename
winfs-act-rename.description: Renames a single selected item via the inline input-prompt overlay (Explorer-style base-name pre-selection).

winfs-act-delete.title: Delete
winfs-act-delete.description: Sends selected item(s) to the Recycle Bin (destructive, red-bordered); Shift forces a permanent delete and the button flashes the override state.

winfs-act-run.title: Run
winfs-act-run.description: Launches an executable (.exe) directly; matched to the /binary/executable experience.

winfs-act-install.title: Install
winfs-act-install.description: Runs a Windows installer package (.msi/.msix/.msixbundle); matched to the /binary/installer experience.

winfs-act-properties.title: Properties
winfs-act-properties.description: Opens the native Windows file/folder properties dialog for a single item.

winfs-act-openwith.title: Open With
winfs-act-openwith.description: Shows the native 'Open with…' chooser; sorted to the end of the strip as the gateway to any other app.

winfs-act-shellverbs.title: Shell Verb Actions
winfs-act-shellverbs.description: Per-file buttons derived from the Windows registry's shell verbs (Edit, Print, …) for the selected file's type, shown with a distinct border and only when registry mapping is enabled.

winfs-act-customapp.title: Custom External-App Actions
winfs-act-customapp.description: User-defined external-app launch buttons (criteria-matched by extension/path glob), expanding #file/#filepath tokens and %VAR% environment variables with configurable multi-file behaviour.

winfs-action-context-menu.title: Action Button Context Menu
winfs-action-context-menu.description: Right-clicking an action button offers 'Modify' (jump to the relevant Options editor for a custom app or internal viewer) and 'Add to Ribbon' (pin a non-destructive action).

winfs-ribbon-pin.title: Pin Action / Tab to Ribbon
winfs-ribbon-pin.description: A file action (or the whole file tab) can be dragged or pinned onto the ribbon and re-launched later against the same files/folder.

winfs-context-menu.title: File/Folder Context Menu
winfs-context-menu.description: Right-clicking entries (in list or tree) or empty space pops a themed menu of the applicable file/folder actions for the right-clicked selection.

winfs-create.title: New / Create Overlay
winfs-create.description: The 'New' button opens an overlay to pick a file type from an icon grid and name it, with a live duplicate-name warning and Explorer-style extension handling.

winfs-create-folder.title: New Folder
winfs-create-folder.description: Create-action that makes a new directory in the current folder.

winfs-create-shellnew.title: ShellNew Types
winfs-create-shellnew.description: Create-action entries discovered from the registry's ShellNew handlers, so the New grid offers the same blank document types Windows Explorer does.

winfs-create-template.title: Templated Create
winfs-create-template.description: Create-action entries from user-defined file templates (Templated Create config) that seed a new file from a stored template, plus an Options editor to manage the templates.

winfs-define-new.title: Define New (association wizard)
winfs-define-new.description: Multi-step wizard (launched from a selected file) that associates a file/extension/glob with an internal viewer, an existing app, or a new external app, then scopes the rule to this file, this folder, or the whole PC.

winfs-external-apps-editor.title: External Apps Editor
winfs-external-apps-editor.description: Options page to add/edit/remove external-app launch definitions (path, args, icon, multi-file mode, match criteria) used by the custom-app actions.

winfs-filemap-editor.title: File Type Actions Editor
winfs-filemap-editor.description: Options page mapping experiences (viewers/actions) to file types via criteria (extension, perceived/content type, magic number), seeded from the bundled default-filemap.json and used to resolve the default-open action.

winfs-confirm-overlay.title: Confirmation Overlay
winfs-confirm-overlay.description: Modal danger-styled prompt covering the page, used to confirm destructive operations like permanent delete.

winfs-input-prompt.title: Input Prompt Overlay
winfs-input-prompt.description: Modal single-field prompt (used for rename) with Enter-to-confirm / Esc-to-cancel and base-name pre-selection.

winfs-drag-drop.title: Drag & Drop
winfs-drag-drop.description: Drag selected entries out as file drops, and drop external/internal files onto the list or a tree folder to copy (or move with Shift), with a cursor-following drop-description tooltip.

winfs-keyboard.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
winfs-keyboard.description: Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V copy/cut/paste, Delete (Shift+Delete = permanent) delete, and Ctrl+A select-all, routed through the same action code path as the buttons.

winfs-viewlet-host.title: Folder Viewlets Host
winfs-viewlet-host.description: Hosts contextual folder viewlets (e.g. .NET solution, git repo) for the current folder, stacking compact ones above the list or letting a 'Full' viewlet take over the pane with file/viewlet toggle and a cycle button.

winfs-ai-tools.title: AI File Tools
winfs-ai-tools.description: Client tools the agent can call against the current folder: list/find files, read contents, line/file stats, create text file/directory, copy, move, rename, delete — confined to the tab's folder as security context.

winfs-ai-context.title: AI Context & Security Risk
winfs-ai-context.description: Supplies the agent a context line (location, counts, selection, viewlet lines) plus a security risk rating (High for This PC / system roots / Windows folder, Medium for other drive roots, Low otherwise).

compressed-inspector.title: Archive Inspector Tab
compressed-inspector.description: The Compressed tab opened by the 'As Archive' file action: a left metadata pane, a center expandable entry tree, a right action bar and a status line. Reads everything through IVirtualFileSystem so it works for every registered format.

compressed-metadata-pane.title: Metadata Pane
compressed-metadata-pane.description: Left pane showing the archive's file name, format, entry count, uncompressed/compressed sizes, percent saved, encryption state, signature state and any archive comment.

compressed-entry-tree.title: Entry Tree
compressed-entry-tree.description: Center directory tree built from the flat entry list, with chevrons to expand/collapse folders, summed folder sizes, and Name/Size/Packed/Ratio/Modified columns. Single-click chevron toggles a folder; double-click a file opens it in its normal viewer.

compressed-open-inner-file.title: Open File Inside Archive
compressed-open-inner-file.description: Double-clicking (or activating) a file row routes its virtual path through the shell's VFS-aware opener, so an inner file opens in its normal viewer without manual extraction.

compressed-actionbar.title: Action Bar
compressed-actionbar.description: Right-hand 2-column icon-button strip with capability-gated commands: Extract, Add file, Test, Encrypt, Decrypt, Sign, Sig Check, Recompress and Convert. Buttons enable/disable from the archive's advertised capabilities.

compressed-extract.title: Extract
compressed-extract.description: Picks a destination folder and extracts every entry there (zip-slip guarded by the VFS).

compressed-addfile.title: Add File
compressed-addfile.description: Picks a file and adds (or replaces) it inside the archive by rewriting the container. Enabled only for modify-capable formats (zip family); also reachable by drag-and-drop onto the page.

compressed-editwriteback.title: Edit & Write Back
compressed-editwriteback.description: An inner file opened from the archive can be edited and saved; the VFS materialises it to a temp file, then rewrites the owning container with the new bytes (modify-capable formats only).

compressed-test.title: Test
compressed-test.description: Reads every entry stream end-to-end and reports how many verified vs failed — an integrity check without extracting to disk.

compressed-encrypt.title: Encrypt
compressed-encrypt.description: Prompts for a password and writes an AES-256 encrypted zip copy via the SecureZip provider. Enabled when an IArchiveEncryptor can encrypt the current archive (.zip).

compressed-decrypt.title: Decrypt
compressed-decrypt.description: Prompts for the password and writes a plain (decrypted) zip copy, removing AES encryption. Errors gracefully on a wrong password.

compressed-sign.title: Sign
compressed-sign.description: Hashes the whole archive and signs the hash with a per-user ECDSA P-256 key, writing a detached <archive>.sig sidecar and showing the signer fingerprint.

compressed-verify.title: Sig Check
compressed-verify.description: Recomputes the archive hash and verifies it against the embedded public key in the .sig sidecar, reporting valid/invalid plus the fingerprint. Enabled only when a signature exists.

compressed-recompress.title: Recompress
compressed-recompress.description: Opens a level picker (Store / Fast / Optimal / Smallest) and repackages the archive in place at the chosen compression level. Disabled for uncompressed .tar.

compressed-convert.title: Convert
compressed-convert.description: Opens an icon-badge format grid and rewrites the archive to a sibling in the chosen target format. Offers multi-entry containers (zip/tar/tar.gz/…) always, and single-stream codecs (gz/zst/lz4/…) only when the archive holds exactly one file.

compressed-overlays.title: Choice & Password Overlays
compressed-overlays.description: Modal in-tab overlays: a choice picker (level list for Recompress, icon-badge grid for Convert) and a password box (Encrypt/Decrypt). The PasswordBox can't be data-bound, so its value is submitted from the view code-behind.

compressed-droptarget.title: Drag-and-Drop Add
compressed-droptarget.description: Files dropped onto the page are added to the archive (skipped for read-only formats), reusing the same add-and-rebuild path as the Add file button.

compressed-vfs.title: Virtual Filesystem (Browse Like a Folder)
compressed-vfs.description: Process-wide IVirtualFileSystem facade: real paths pass straight through, while paths descending into a registered archive resolve entries by materialising them (and any nested containers) to cached temp files, so callers always see an ordinary seekable file. Backs browse, open, edit-write-back, extract, add, repackage and create.

compressed-browse-as-folder.title: Browse Archive in File Tree
compressed-browse-as-folder.description: IDynamicFolder makes archive files browsable like folders in the file explorer. Archive-primary formats expand on double-click; zip-based document formats (.docx/.xlsx/…) stay browsable on request but keep their normal open.

compressed-fileactions.title: File / Folder Actions
compressed-fileactions.description: The right-click / action-strip entry points that don't need the inspector tab: open As Archive, Unzip here, and (on a folder) Zip It.

compressed-open-as-archive.title: As Archive (Open)
compressed-open-as-archive.description: File action matched to archive files (the /archive experience) that opens the Compressed inspector tab for the file.

compressed-unzip-here.title: Unzip Here
compressed-unzip-here.description: Extracts an archive into a new uniquely-named sibling folder (handles compound extensions like .tar.gz), without opening a tab.

compressed-zip-it.title: Zip It
compressed-zip-it.description: Folder action that compresses a folder into a sibling archive of the configured default format (a format-pick overlay is offered once more than one create-capable format is installed).

compressed-backends.title: Format Backends
compressed-backends.description: Pluggable archive handlers + single-stream codecs registered into the VFS, defining which formats can be listed, extracted, created or modified. Discovered by assembly name (Nexaflow.Features.Compressed.*).

compressed-backend-zip.title: ZIP Backend (in-box)
compressed-backend-zip.description: In-box zip-family backend (System.IO.Compression) covering .zip plus zip-based document/package formats (Office, OpenDocument, epub, apk, jar, nupkg, vsix, …). Full list + extract + create + modify; no external dependency.

compressed-backend-sharpcompress.title: tar / 7z / rar Backend
compressed-backend-sharpcompress.description: SharpCompress read-only backend for tar, 7-Zip, RAR and the single-stream compressors (gzip/bzip2/xz); compressed tars surface their inner .tar for the VFS to descend. Can create the tar family only (tar / tar.gz / tar.bz2).

compressed-backend-modern.title: zstd / lz4 Backend
compressed-backend-modern.description: Modern single-stream codecs — Zstandard (.zst / .tar.zst) and LZ4 (.lz4 / .tar.lz4) — used for compress/decompress and as Convert targets.

compressed-backend-securezip.title: AES-256 Zip Backend
compressed-backend-securezip.description: SecureZip provider (SharpZipLib) for whole-archive AES-256 zip encryption — powers the Encrypt/Decrypt actions.

registry-toolbar.title: Toolbar
registry-toolbar.description: Top bar with the hive dropdown (HKCU / HKLM / HKCR) plus Export and Import buttons.

registry-hive-dropdown.title: Hive Dropdown
registry-hive-dropdown.description: Selects which root hive the tree shows — HKEY_CURRENT_USER, HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE or HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT — and navigates to that hive root.

registry-export.title: Export
registry-export.description: Exports the selected key (and subtree) to a .reg file via reg.exe export.

registry-import.title: Import
registry-import.description: Imports a .reg file via reg.exe import, retrying elevated through the bridge when an in-process write into a protected hive is denied.

registry-key-tree.title: Key Tree
registry-key-tree.description: Left lazy-loaded TreeView of keys rooted at the hive (or at a pinned key). Selecting a node navigates to it and drives breadcrumbs; navigation stays at or below the tree base. Right-click selects the node and opens the key context menu.

registry-new-key.title: New Key
registry-new-key.description: Key context-menu action: prompts for a name and creates a child key under the current key, then navigates into it (in-process with elevation fallback).

registry-rename-key.title: Rename Key
registry-rename-key.description: Key context-menu action: renames the current key to a new leaf name (refused at a hive root), reloads the tree and navigates to the renamed key.

registry-delete-key.title: Delete Key
registry-delete-key.description: Key context-menu action: deletes the current key and all subkeys/values after a confirmation overlay (refused at a hive root).

registry-value-list.title: Value List
registry-value-list.description: Right GridView of the current key's values (Name / Type / Data), with a synthesised (Default) row, sortable columns and a per-value context menu. Double-clicking a value opens its edit prompt.

registry-modify-value.title: Modify Value
registry-modify-value.description: Value context-menu / double-click action: seeds an edit box from the existing value, parses the typed data for its kind (REG_SZ/DWORD/QWORD/BINARY/MULTI_SZ/…) and writes it back under the current key.

registry-new-value.title: New Value
registry-new-value.description: Value context-menu 'New' submenu: creates a String, Expandable String, DWORD, QWORD, Binary or Multi-String value under the current key after prompting for a name.

registry-delete-value.title: Delete Value
registry-delete-value.description: Value context-menu action: deletes the selected value after a confirmation overlay (the default value can't be deleted, only cleared).

registry-write-elevation.title: Elevation-gated Writes
registry-write-elevation.description: Every mutation tries an in-process write first and, on access-denied, falls back to the elevation bridge (user-approved, declinable). The wire encoding stays byte-identical between in-process and elevated so the same edit produces the same bytes either way.

registry-overlays.title: Input & Confirmation Overlays
registry-overlays.description: In-tab modal overlays mirroring the file-system tab: a text-input prompt (new/rename/edit) and a danger-styled confirmation (delete key/value).

registry-pin-to-ribbon.title: Pin Key to Ribbon
registry-pin-to-ribbon.description: Pinning a registry tab re-roots the tree at the current key and bakes that hive+path into the ribbon button, so it always re-opens rooted at that exact key.

registry-ai-tools.title: AI Registry Tools
registry-ai-tools.description: Four client tools exposed to the AI: read-only list-subkeys and get-values (downward-only navigation, no '..', drive letters or hive names), and approval-gated set-value / insert-value that share the UI's write path.

registry-ai-list-subkeys.title: AI: List Subkeys
registry-ai-list-subkeys.description: Read-only tool listing child key names under the current key or a downward relative path.

registry-ai-get-values.title: AI: Get Values
registry-ai-get-values.description: Read-only tool listing a key's values and moving the view to that key so the user sees what the model reads.

registry-ai-set-value.title: AI: Set Value
registry-ai-set-value.description: Approval-gated tool that changes an existing value under the current key, keeping its type unless 'type' is given.

registry-ai-insert-value.title: AI: Insert Value
registry-ai-insert-value.description: Approval-gated tool that creates a new value of a given type under the current key.

search-topbar.title: Top Bar
search-topbar.description: Header showing the search root/scope on the left, the active query (with a search glyph) in the center, and the status / live-search spinner on the right.

search-scope-root.title: Scope / Root
search-scope-root.description: The search scope: a single folder root (from the originating Files tab) or, when no root is given but drives are available, a fan-out across all drives. The SCOPE clause is built from the root URI.

search-query-parser.title: Query Parser
search-query-parser.description: Converts the raw user query into an OLE DB SQL WHERE clause: quoted phrases, file globs (*.cs), +required/-excluded prefix syntax, size:/date:/modified:/before:/after:/larger:/smaller: filters, and plain content+filename terms (with SQL/LIKE escaping).

search-index-query.title: SystemIndex Query (OLE DB)
search-index-query.description: Runs the parsed WHERE clause against the Windows Search SystemIndex via the Search.CollatorDSO OLE DB provider on a background thread, returning up to 500 entries newest-first; handles service-unavailable gracefully.

search-results-list.title: Results List
search-results-list.description: GridView of matches (Name with file/folder icon, Location relative to root, Size, Modified) with virtualization and an empty-state 'No results found.' overlay.

search-column-sort.title: Column Sort
search-column-sort.description: Clicking a column header sorts results by that field (Name/Location/Size/Modified), toggling ascending/descending and showing an arrow indicator.

search-actionstrip.title: Action Strip
search-actionstrip.description: Right-hand icon-button strip (matching the file explorer's) acting on the selected result.

search-open-location.title: Open Location
search-open-location.description: Opens the selected result's containing folder in a new Files tab.

search-open-file.title: Open File
search-open-file.description: Opens the selected result with its default application via the shell.

search-ai-query.title: AI Query Routing
search-ai-query.description: A stateless scorer rates how query-like an input is (globs, quoted terms, prefixes, property filters) vs a sentence; the '?' query handler launches a search from a Files tab and refines an existing Search tab.

search-ai-launch.title: AI: Launch Search
search-ai-launch.description: The '?' handler that, on a FileSystem tab, opens a new Search tab scoped to the current directory (or all drives) with the typed query — routing bare absolute paths to navigation instead.

search-ai-refine.title: AI: Refine Search
search-ai-refine.description: The '?' handler that, on an active Search tab, merges the new input with the original query using AND and re-queries Windows Search so all constraints apply together.

search-ai-tool.title: AI: Search Tool
search-ai-tool.description: An in-tab client tool the AI can call to run a search by query string, surfacing the full Advanced Query Syntax (kinds, globs, quoted phrases, property/size/date filters, +/- prefixes).

aibar-input-group.title: Input Cluster
aibar-input-group.description: The centre input zone of the AI bar: the multiline prompt box flanked by the status/clear cluster on the left and the context/mic cluster on the right.

aibar-input-textbox.title: Prompt Text Box
aibar-input-textbox.description: Multiline 'Ask anything…' input (PlaceholderTextBox): placeholder hint when empty, local spell-check with a themed context menu, Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a newline. Disabled while the AI is busy or the mic is listening; text turns cyan while the AI types a prefill.

aibar-ghost-completion.title: Ghost-Text Completion
aibar-ghost-completion.description: Grey inline completion drawn after the caret, proposed by the clear-winner query handler's CompleteAsync; Tab accepts it and appends. Re-scored 150ms after each keystroke and dropped when the text changes or the mic owns the input.

aibar-send.title: Send Button
aibar-send.description: The ➤ submit button (Enter also sends): runs SendAiMessage, which routes to a matching IQueryHandler or the client-side agent loop. Spans the full bar height when idle.

aibar-cancel.title: Cancel Button
aibar-cancel.description: While the agent runs, the send button morphs into a red ■ Cancel that trips the run's cancellation token and restores the typed message to the bar. (Token plumbing into providers is partial — the request may still complete.)

aibar-queue.title: Queue Message Button
aibar-queue.description: A ➤＋ button that appears above Cancel only while the agent is working: submitting enqueues the message as an interjection delivered at the next turn boundary so the user can steer mid-task without cancelling.

aibar-clear.title: Clear Input
aibar-clear.description: The ⊗ button (left cluster) empties the prompt box; disabled while the AI is busy.

aibar-status-dot.title: AI Status Dot
aibar-status-dot.description: Animated indicator left of the prompt with four prioritised states: busy (orange size-pulse), single-handler identified (indigo circle showing the handler's symbol), listening/ambiguous (indigo→cyan opacity-pulse), and ready (steady green). Each state reads its own AiStatus.* theme token.

aibar-chat-key-hooks.title: Page Chat-Bar Hooks
aibar-chat-key-hooks.description: The active page's feature gets first crack at the bar: claim a key press (IChatKeyHandler — e.g. terminal Up/Down history, Tab path completion), turn a dropped file into inserted text (IChatDropHandler), or mirror typing back into the page (IChatInputPreview, e.g. terminal echo). Discovered per-workspace by FeatureManager.

title_path: AI input bar — key / preview / drop handlers (`Services/`)

aibar-prefill.title: Prefill Type-In
aibar-prefill.description: When the agent answers with a prefill block, the bar clears and the suggested text is typed in character-by-character (cyan) for the user to review and send, rather than executing.

aibar-voice-config.title: Voice Settings (Whisper Model)
aibar-voice-config.description: An Options 'Voice' section to pick the Whisper model size (Base/Small/Medium/Large-v3) and language (English-only/Multilingual), with a download-status panel, progress bar, and a 'Download now' button that fetches the ggml model from Hugging Face.

aibar-response-overlay.title: AI Response Overlay
aibar-response-overlay.description: The shell's modal popup (~80% of the page area) that renders the agent's activity when the active page can't host responses itself. Dims and blocks the page behind it but leaves the AI bar live so the user can cancel; slides up to open and is bound to ShellAIResponseHandler.

aibar-progress-line.title: Live Progress Line
aibar-progress-line.description: While the agent works, the overlay/banner shows a centred italic activity line (overwritten on each step — 'Considering', 'Working', tool names) with an animated ellipsis. Driven by IAIResponseHandler.ReportProgress.

aibar-tool-approval.title: Tool-Batch Approval
aibar-tool-approval.description: Before a mutating tool batch runs, the overlay/banner shows the model's explanation plus a 'Run X?' summary with Accept / Deny pills; Accept resumes the run, Deny (and closing) resolves the gate as denied. Read-only batches auto-run without this prompt.

aibar-plan-approval.title: Plan Approval
aibar-plan-approval.description: For a proposed multi-step plan the overlay renders the plan title, a Mermaid diagram, and a numbered step list (decision points / tool tags), gated by a single Accept / Deny covering the whole plan.

aibar-final-answer.title: Final Answer Render
aibar-final-answer.description: The model's final answer rendered as selectable, scrollable markdown (via SelectableMarkdownView) in the overlay/banner body, with the persona name and ✦ in the accent header.

aibar-continue-conversation.title: Continue as Conversation
aibar-continue-conversation.description: A footer button on a finished answer that saves the prompt+answer (with any agent-touched files) as a conversation record, opens it in the AIChat tab, and pins the origin tab as a live context item.

aibar-overlay-close.title: Dismiss Overlay
aibar-overlay-close.description: The ✕ header button closes the overlay; if a tool/plan approval is pending, dismissing resolves it as a deny.

aibar-response-banner.title: Inline Response Banner
aibar-response-banner.description: A dissolvable banner injected at the bottom of an IChatEngagement page (e.g. under the console): same progress/approval/answer chrome as the overlay but in-page. Slides up to open and dissolves when the page takes the next action (e.g. running a command).

aibar-banner-escalate.title: Escalate to Overlay
aibar-banner-escalate.description: When a final answer is taller than the in-page banner can show, it hands the answer to the modal overlay and dissolves — but only while the engagement page is the active tab, so a background result stays scrollable in the banner.

aibar-activity-ticker.title: Background Activity Ticker
aibar-activity-ticker.description: A small marquee in the top-left chrome that shows the most-recent background task with a status glyph (⟳ running, ✓ done, ✕ failed), fading in on change and scrolling long descriptions. Independent of AI-bar busy state — background work never locks AI input.

chrome-messages-button.title: Messages Button + Unread Badge
chrome-messages-button.description: Top-bar button (envelope icon + 'Messages' label) that opens the notifications panel; a rounded accent badge shows the unread count and hides at zero. Opening marks all as read and clears the badge.

chrome-notifications-panel.title: Notifications Panel
chrome-notifications-panel.description: Right-anchored 640px-wide inbox listing every message (selectable title/body, per-message action buttons, per-item dismiss ✕). Shows an empty 'No notifications' state; a transparent full-window scrim dismisses it on click-outside.

chrome-toast.title: Notification Toast
chrome-toast.description: Transient bottom-right card surfacing one message at a time (further posts queue). Severity drives icon + border colour (Info=accent ℹ, Warning ⚠, Error ⚠ danger, Update ⬆); shows the body in a scrollable region, renders the message's action buttons, auto-dismisses by severity, and can be closed with ✕.

chrome-message-actions.title: Message Action Buttons
chrome-message-actions.description: Action buttons carried by a message (e.g. an update's 'Install', or 'Open' to jump to a tab) rendered identically in both the toast and the inbox panel; the primary action is accent-styled. ShowNotification(message, tab) attaches an 'Open' action that activates the owning tab.

chrome-show-error.title: Show Error (toast)
chrome-show-error.description: IShellServices.ShowError posts an Error-severity message that always toasts (danger-bordered) and lands in the inbox — the shell's way for any feature to surface a failure.

chrome-show-notification.title: Show Notification
chrome-show-notification.description: IShellServices.ShowNotification posts an Info message to the shared inbox (no toast unless a tab overload is used, which toasts with an 'Open' action) — a feature's non-urgent status channel.

chrome-prompts.title: Shell Prompt Overlays
chrome-prompts.description: Window-level modal dialogs the shell raises for feature/shell actions, distinct from page content. Covers the single-field input prompt (ShowPrompt) and the yes/no confirmation (ShowConfirmation); Escape cancels either.

chrome-prompt-input.title: Input Prompt Dialog
chrome-prompt-input.description: Modal centred dialog with a title, label, and a single text box (Enter=OK, Escape=Cancel); the box auto-focuses and selects-all on open. Used by file actions like Rename/Save As.

chrome-prompt-confirm.title: Confirmation Dialog
chrome-prompt-confirm.description: Modal centred yes/no dialog (title, wrapped message, Cancel + accent Confirm buttons) used by the ribbon's Delete and any shell action needing a guard, including the destructive Reset Config / Delete workspace flows.

chrome-activity-ticker.title: Activity Ticker
chrome-activity-ticker.description: Single-line status strip in the top-bar logo column showing the most-recent background task with a state prefix (⟳ running, ✓ done, ✕ failed) and a colour shift for failures. Fades in on each change and slowly marquee-scrolls text wider than the strip.

chrome-activity-handle.title: Activity Reporting (IActivityHandle)
chrome-activity-handle.description: The provider/feature-facing handle returned by StartActivity: Complete() marks success, Fail(reason) appends the reason and flags failure; the last completion restores the Idle placeholder and flips IsActive off.

chrome-breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb Bar
chrome-breadcrumb.description: Left side of the tab bar, bound to the active page's Breadcrumbs. Renders clickable path segments separated by ›; adaptively compresses to fit (progressively shortens the longest middle label, then collapses to first › (long path) › second-last › last so root/up are always reachable). Full label always shown on hover.

chrome-breadcrumb-navigate.title: Same-tab Navigate Segment
chrome-breadcrumb-navigate.description: A leaf crumb whose Navigate action moves within the current tab (no new tab) when clicked — e.g. stepping up a folder in the file explorer's own view.

chrome-breadcrumb-crosstab.title: Cross-tab Follow Segment
chrome-breadcrumb-crosstab.description: A crumb with a TargetPageKind (+ optional params) that opens/raises a different tab when clicked, via the shell's OpenTabRequested; the control stays decoupled from Page and the shell resolves the factory. E.g. a file leaf jumping to the FileSystem explorer.

chrome-breadcrumb-dropdown.title: Segment Dropdown
chrome-breadcrumb-dropdown.description: A crumb with sibling Children shows a ▾ chevron and opens a popup list of those siblings on click — sideways navigation at that path level.

chrome-tabstrip.title: Tab Strip
chrome-tabstrip.description: Right side of the tab bar: the row of open tabs for a pane. Each tab shows the page icon + title, drives active/hover styling from its Page, and reveals a ✕ close on hover. Tabs are data-bound so the strip tracks Page changes; a right-click on empty strip area offers Split / Close pane.

chrome-tab-activate.title: Activate Tab
chrome-tab-activate.description: Click a tab to bring it to front and select it as the pane's active page; activation fires on mouse-up so an inactive tab can be clicked without losing the drag-arm closure.

chrome-tab-close.title: Close Tab
chrome-tab-close.description: Per-tab ✕ button (hover-revealed) that closes the page; the close glyph brightens on its own hover and the click is handled before tab activation.

chrome-tab-overflow.title: Tab Overflow Menu
chrome-tab-overflow.description: When tabs exceed the strip width a right-anchored ••• button appears; clicking opens a popup list of the hidden tabs (icon + title) that activates the chosen one. Width is re-measured on resize and collection change.

chrome-tab-tearoff-drag.title: Tab Drag / Tear-off Source
chrome-tab-tearoff-drag.description: Drag a tab to move it: drop on another window's strip re-docks it there, drop on another pane moves it cross-pane, drop on the desktop tears it into a new window. Drag begins after a small move while LMB is held; a hand cursor signals every drop is a Move. (The tear-off outcome is tracked under Window Handling → tear-off.)

chrome-tab-context-menu.title: Tab Context Menu
chrome-tab-context-menu.description: Right-click a tab for: Split right, Close except this, Pin to Ribbon, Open in New Window, and Close pane — items appear only when their command can execute against the live pane.

chrome-tab-pin-ribbon.title: Pin Tab to Ribbon
chrome-tab-pin-ribbon.description: Tab context-menu 'Pin to Ribbon' raises a TabPinRequest so the open page becomes a persistent ribbon button.

chrome-frame.title: Main Window Frame
chrome-frame.description: The custom-chromed shell window hosting every region: drag bar, top bar (logo+ticker / ribbon / messages+options), the content area (panes → breadcrumb + tab strip + page), and the AI interaction bar. Uses a borderless WindowChrome with a themed window backdrop and an Escape key that closes all open overlays.

chrome-titlebar.title: Custom Title Bar / Window Controls
chrome-titlebar.description: Full-width caption strip with the draggable bar and top-right Minimise / Maximise-Restore / Close buttons (Segoe MDL2 glyphs, red close hover). The maximise glyph + tooltip flip on state change and the frame pads when maximised; integrates Windows 11 snap-layout hover via SnapLayoutHook.

chrome-topbar.title: Top Bar
chrome-topbar.description: The 72px band above the content: left logo column (gradient NexaFlow mark + activity ticker), centre self-contained ribbon, and right action cluster (Options + Messages). Each column carries its own chrome surface so themes can retint it.

chrome-options-button.title: Options Button
chrome-options-button.description: Top-bar action that toggles the full-screen modal Options overlay.

chrome-content-area.title: Content Area (Pane Host)
chrome-content-area.description: The star-sized middle region that hosts the root pane node — one PaneView (breadcrumb + tab strip + active page) or a split of two side-by-side. A resizable splitter separates it from the AI bar below.

chrome-aibar.title: AI Interaction Bar
chrome-aibar.description: The bottom region (its own themeable AiBar region): status dot + clear-input cluster on the left, the multi-line ask box in the centre, the Send/Cancel button (swaps to Cancel + a Queue button while the agent is busy, or a listening icon while recording) and the context-toggle + mic cluster on the right. Ctrl+Tab focuses it from anywhere.

chrome-aistatusdot.title: AI Status Dot
chrome-aistatusdot.description: Animated indicator in the AI bar: green steady = ready, orange size-pulse = busy, indigo→cyan opacity-pulse = listening/ambiguous, or an indigo circle showing a single handler's symbol (surfacing the AI intent symbol). Tooltip names the current state.

chrome-ai-input.title: Ask Box (AI Input)
chrome-ai-input.description: The multi-line, wrapping prompt box with placeholder and inline AI completion suggestion (Tab to accept); Enter sends, Shift+Enter newlines. Disabled while the agent is processing or the mic is listening; accepts dropped file paths and feature key/insert routing.

chrome-ai-send.title: Send / Cancel / Queue Button
chrome-ai-send.description: Primary AI action ➤ (Send) that becomes ■ Cancel (red) while the agent works — with a ➤＋ Queue button appearing above it to add a follow-up that's delivered at the next step — or a 👂 stop-listening button while recording.

chrome-ai-clear.title: Clear Input Button
chrome-ai-clear.description: ⊗ button in the left cluster that clears the ask box; disabled while the AI is busy.

chrome-aibar-splitter.title: AI Bar Resize Splitter
chrome-aibar-splitter.description: Horizontal GridSplitter between the content area and the AI bar; the AI row height is clamped to half the window (min ~72px) so the mic/context cluster stays visible.

chrome-jumplist.title: Taskbar Jump List
chrome-jumplist.description: Windows taskbar jump list under a 'Workspaces' category: one task per profile that relaunches the app with --context "Name" to open straight into that profile. Rebuilt whenever the profile list changes; failures are swallowed so it never breaks startup.

opt-property-grid.title: Property Grid
opt-property-grid.description: Reflection-generated sectioned editor: for a config with no [CustomControl], OptionsViewModel reflects every public read/write property into a labelled row whose editor kind is chosen from the property type plus its attributes. Edits go to a Clone; ApplyToReal copies back on Save.

opt-editor-textbox.title: Text / Number Row
opt-editor-textbox.description: Default editor: a labelled TextBox with a hover/focus reveal clear (✕) button. String values pass through; numeric property types are coerced (int/long/double/decimal) on commit.

opt-editor-folderpath.title: Folder Path Picker
opt-editor-folderpath.description: [FolderPath] property: TextBox + '…' browse button (themed FolderBrowserWindow) with live existence validation — a non-empty path that doesn't exist shows a red border and tooltip.

opt-editor-filepath.title: File Path Picker
opt-editor-filepath.description: [FilePath(".ext"…)] property: TextBox + '…' browse button (FileBrowserWindow filtered to the declared extensions) with file-exists validation.

opt-editor-enum.title: Enum Combo
opt-editor-enum.description: An enum-typed property renders as a ComboBox; each option's friendly label comes from the enum field's [Description], persisting the underlying enum name.

opt-editor-listsource.title: List-Source Combo
opt-editor-listsource.description: [ListSource(type, method)] property: ComboBox populated at build time from a static IEnumerable<string> method (e.g. installed fonts/shells).

opt-editor-toggle.title: Toggle Switch
opt-editor-toggle.description: A bool property renders as a themed ToggleSwitch.

opt-disabledif-gating.title: Conditional Enable (DisabledIf)
opt-disabledif-gating.description: [DisabledIfSet]/[DisabledIfNotSet] grey out an editor based on a sibling property's value, re-evaluated whenever the sibling changes; two on a pair gives mutual exclusion. A disabled field never shows as invalid.

opt-save-validate.title: Save / Validate / Dirty Tracking
opt-save-validate.description: Save is enabled only when every section is valid; per-section HasChanges/IsValid/IsRequiredSatisfied drive Apply. Required fields are 'all-empty or all-filled'. Custom-control sections report state via IConfigValidation / IConfigChangeTracker and persist via ICustomConfigApply. On Save each section's RealConfig is written through ConfigManager and affected tabs are asked to refresh.

opt-section-shell.title: Shell Settings
opt-section-shell.description: Custom-control section for ShellConfig: theme picker (with live palette swatches + restart notice), language picker, and a 'Start with Windows' toggle that preloads Nexaflow at login and syncs the HKCU Run key.

opt-section-voice.title: Voice Settings
opt-section-voice.description: Custom-control section for VoiceConfig: pick one Whisper model (size × language) from a combined list, with a per-model suitability note and a download-status panel (downloaded / downloading-with-% / a 'Download now' button).

opt-section-filetype-actions.title: File-Type Actions Editor
opt-section-filetype-actions.description: Custom-control section (shipped by the WindowsFileSystem feature, surfaced in Options): a tree mapping file extensions/globs to the viewer or external app that opens them, editable per type.

opt-section-workspaces.title: Workspaces (Profiles) Editor
opt-section-workspaces.description: Custom-control section for WorkspacesConfig: the profile list — add / clone / delete a workspace, edit each one's name, symbol and colour (swatch bank + hex), drag to reorder, and a per-row Configure button into the Manage-AI panel. The active workspace can't be deleted.

opt-manage-ai.title: Manage AI / Configure Workspace
opt-manage-ai.description: The per-workspace 'Configure' panel: a section list (Workspace identity, AI ability grid, AI persona, per-provider configs, per-workspace feature configs) editing a disk-backed copy of one profile. Apply writes the current section to disk; Close rebuilds the live workspace once if anything was applied. Footer = Apply (dirty-gated) + Close.

opt-ai-ability-grid.title: AI Ability Grid
opt-ai-ability-grid.description: A matrix assigning each AI ability (one row) to a provider/model column via a single-select radio dot, including a 'None' column. Add a column by picking a configured provider then a model (models fetched live, defaulting to the first); remove a column with its × button.
