Only providers whose required config (API key) is satisfied appear in the picker.

opt-ai-add-column.title: Add Provider / Model Column
opt-ai-add-column.description: Inline panel to add a grid column: a provider combo (configured providers only) and a model combo whose options are fetched from the provider (with a 'loading…' hint); Add is enabled once both are chosen.

opt-ai-persona.title: AI Persona
opt-ai-persona.description: Per-profile persona editor: the assistant's display Name (shown on the response overlay) and the System Prompt prepended to every conversation. Tracks its own changes via IConfigChangeTracker.

opt-provider-config.title: Provider Config / API Keys
opt-provider-config.description: One reflected property-grid section per discovered provider (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, Aria): API keys / endpoints / [Required] fields. Saving a provider key re-acquires the editing provider set so the ability grid can list that provider's models.

opt-workspace-identity.title: Workspace Identity Page
opt-workspace-identity.description: First page of Configure: edit the workspace name/symbol/colour (live preview tile + swatch bank + hex), export all conversations to markdown, and a danger-zone Delete Workspace. A rename moves the data folder and triggers a workspace rebuild on close.

opt-about.title: About Page
opt-about.description: Read-only About section (floated to the bottom of the Options list): product name, version, source link, and a collapsible third-party-notices list rendered from a bundled markdown asset.

opt-reset-config.title: Reset Config (Danger)
opt-reset-config.description: Danger-styled 'Reset Config…' button in About: confirmation-gated, wipes the entire %APPDATA%\Smile\nexaflow tree (every setting, workspace, provider and conversation for all profiles) and relaunches into first-run.

opt-setup-wizard.title: Setup Wizard
opt-setup-wizard.description: First-run / post-update modal wizard: a stepper with Back / Skip / Next(Finish), a 'Step N of M' indicator, and per-step completion gating Next. Built from whatever genuinely needs configuring; returns null (no wizard) when nothing does. Skip launches with defaults so it's never a dead end.

opt-wizard-whatsnew.title: What's New Step
opt-wizard-whatsnew.description: Optional first step shown on a fresh install or after a version bump: a read-only markdown changelog from a bundled asset. Always complete.

opt-wizard-mandatory-configs.title: Mandatory Config Steps
opt-wizard-mandatory-configs.description: One step per GLOBAL feature config that opts in via [MandatorySetup] and is either brand-new (defaulted) or migrated-but-missing genuinely-new required info; each reuses the shared config editor and is prefilled with migrated values. Migrated configs whose required fields all carried over are skipped (no re-ask).

opt-wizard-ai-bootstrap.title: AI Bootstrap (Provider → Key → Model)
opt-wizard-ai-bootstrap.description: The mandatory first-workspace AI flow, run when the startup profile has no usable AI assignment: pick a provider, enter its config (API key), then pick a model — which is assigned to every AI ability. Always runs as part of first-run/Add-Workspace setup.

opt-config-migration.title: Config Versioning & Migration
opt-config-migration.description: Each config persists as config_{AssemblyVersion}.json; on a version bump ConfigManager migrates the newest older file forward (lenient field carry-over + optional IConfigMigration.MigrateFrom), so updates keep user data and the wizard re-asks only for genuinely new required info. File-type mappings merge changed bundled defaults while preserving customizations.

ribbon-bar.title: Ribbon Bar
ribbon-bar.description: The rendered horizontal strip itself: lays out items left-to-right, two-pass sizing (preferred → all-compact → overflow), with a profile-accent bevel and the profile selector inset on the left.

ribbon-button-full.title: Ribbon Button (full)
ribbon-button-full.description: Full-height stacked button: large icon over a label. Clicking opens its page kind in a tab (or runs a matching IRibbonItemExecutor). Long labels truncate with an ellipsis; the full label stays on the tooltip.

ribbon-button-half.title: Half-height Button
ribbon-button-half.description: Compact (icon + label side-by-side) button at half ribbon height. Consecutive compact items pair into one vertical column so they stack top/bottom; a lone compact item is top-aligned. Toggled via RibbonItem.IsHalf.

ribbon-separator.title: Separator
ribbon-separator.description: A thin vertical divider between groups of buttons. Pure visual divider — no click behaviour, no styling beyond the border colour.

ribbon-overflow.title: Overflow Menu
ribbon-overflow.description: When items don't fit, a 'More…' button appears and the overflowed buttons drop into a popup list; clicking an entry opens that page. Only engages above a minimum width.

ribbon-edit-toggle.title: Edit / Customise Toggle
ribbon-edit-toggle.description: The full-height arrow button at the right edge of the strip; opens the inline Ribbon Editor overlay (and refreshes the add-page catalog just before showing).

ribbon-accent.title: Button Accent Colour
ribbon-accent.description: Optional per-button colour override (hex) applied to the icon + label foreground; resolved from the categorical Swatch.* theme bank or a custom hex, falling back to the active/muted theme brush. Null = default theme colour.

ribbon-quickedit-group.title: Right-click Quick Edit
ribbon-quickedit-group.description: Per-button context menu on the live ribbon (no need to open the full editor): open-in-new-window, rename, recolour, change icon, grow/shrink (half toggle), delete. Edits flow straight through to ribbon.json and cross-window sync.

ribbon-quickedit-rename.title: Quick Rename
ribbon-quickedit-rename.description: Right-click → Rename: prompts via the shell overlay for a new button caption and rewrites the label live.

ribbon-quickedit-recolour.title: Quick Recolour Flyout
ribbon-quickedit-recolour.description: Right-click → Recolour: pops a swatch palette (Default + the Swatch.* theme bank) anchored under the button; picking a swatch sets the accent colour live.

ribbon-quickedit-icon.title: Quick Change Icon Flyout
ribbon-quickedit-icon.description: Right-click → Change icon: pops a scrolling emoji grid from the shared icon catalogue; picking one sets the button glyph live.

ribbon-quickedit-resize.title: Quick Grow / Shrink
ribbon-quickedit-resize.description: Right-click → Grow/Shrink: toggles the button between full-height and compact (half) in place.

ribbon-quickedit-delete.title: Quick Delete
ribbon-quickedit-delete.description: Right-click → Delete: removes the button after a shell confirmation dialog.

ribbon-quickedit-newwindow.title: Open in New Window
ribbon-quickedit-newwindow.description: Right-click → Open in new Window: opens the button's page in a fresh window of the same workspace (creating the window first so the executor's tabs land there).

ribbon-editor.title: Ribbon Editor
ribbon-editor.description: Full-screen modal overlay for customising the ribbon: a draggable card strip preview + a properties panel + footer actions. All edits happen on a local draft clone; nothing touches the live ribbon until Done. The card opens with the editor card sized to match the live ribbon width.

ribbon-editor-draft.title: Draft / Commit Model
ribbon-editor-draft.description: Editing operates on a cloned draft list; Cancel/✕ discards it, Done commits the draft back into the live collection then saves. The draft re-initialises from the live ribbon every time the overlay is shown so it never shows a stale snapshot.

ribbon-editor-cards.title: Card Strip Preview
ribbon-editor-cards.description: Horizontally scrolling preview of the draft as cards (full / half / paired / separator); clicking a card selects it for editing in the properties panel; the selected card gets an accent border.

ribbon-editor-dragreorder.title: Drag to Reorder
ribbon-editor-dragreorder.description: Drag a card onto another to reorder it within the draft; drop highlights and live-rebuilds the card strip.

ribbon-editor-addpage.title: Add Page Dropdown
ribbon-editor-addpage.description: Footer combo listing every openable page kind not already on the ribbon — each registration's context-item page plus its GetTopLevelPages variants (This PC, named folders, …). '＋ Add' inserts a button for the chosen entry; the entry is dropped from the list so it can't be added twice in one session.

ribbon-editor-rename.title: Rename (Name field)
ribbon-editor-rename.description: Properties-panel NAME text box: live-edits the selected button's label as you type, re-rendering the preview.

ribbon-editor-size.title: Size Toggle (Full / Compact)
ribbon-editor-size.description: Properties-panel SIZE button toggling the selected button between full-height and compact (half).

ribbon-editor-iconpicker.title: Icon Picker Grid
ribbon-editor-iconpicker.description: Properties-panel ICON: a 6-column scrolling emoji grid (shared RibbonStyleCatalog icons); selecting a glyph sets the button icon and highlights the current one.

ribbon-editor-colourpicker.title: Colour Swatches + Hex Input
ribbon-editor-colourpicker.description: Properties-panel COLOUR: a swatch grid (Default + Swatch.* theme bank) and a free-form #RRGGBB / #AARRGGBB hex field; either sets the selected button's accent, validated live.

ribbon-editor-delete.title: Remove Item
ribbon-editor-delete.description: Properties-panel REMOVE / Delete button removing the selected button or separator from the draft.

ribbon-editor-insertsep.title: Insert Separator
ribbon-editor-insertsep.description: Footer button that inserts a separator card before the selected item (or appends it).

ribbon-editor-reset.title: Reset to Defaults
ribbon-editor-reset.description: Footer button that rebuilds the draft from the bundled default ribbon without touching the live ribbon or closing the editor (applies only on Done).

ribbon-editor-done.title: Done / Cancel
ribbon-editor-done.description: Footer Done commits the draft to the live ribbon and saves; Cancel and the ✕ close discard the draft. Done is the only path that persists.

ribbon-pin-group.title: Pin to Ribbon (drag-drop)
ribbon-pin-group.description: Dragging content onto the ribbon strip pins it as a new button: a tab, a file action, or an OS payload like a dropped URL. The drop position computes the insert index; duplicate pins are rejected with a flash. Handlers are auto-discovered per workspace.

ribbon-pin-tab.title: Pin a Dragged Tab
ribbon-pin-tab.description: Drag a tab onto the ribbon to bake it into a button. An ITabPinHandler for the tab's page kind (file-system folder, registry key, tabular transform chain, …) snapshots its exact state; otherwise the tab's current title/icon/params are pinned as-is.

ribbon-pin-fileaction.title: Pin a File Action
ribbon-pin-fileaction.description: Drag a file action onto the ribbon (FileAction drag format) to pin it as a button that re-runs the action against the current selection. Backed by IRibbonPinHandler for creation and IRibbonItemExecutor for click-time run.

ribbon-pin-url.title: Pin a Dropped URL
ribbon-pin-url.description: Drag a URL out of the browser onto the ribbon (native UniformResourceLocator format) to pin a Web button that re-opens that address. Backed by Web's IRibbonPinHandler.

ribbon-pin-dedup.title: Duplicate-pin Rejection Flash
ribbon-pin-dedup.description: Attempting to pin a button that already exists (same page kind + params) is rejected; the existing button flashes its opacity to signal the duplicate.

ribbon-layout-sync.title: Per-profile Layout + Live Sync
ribbon-layout-sync.description: The ribbon layout belongs to the Profile (shared by every Workspace on it) and persists to ribbon.json. Any edit saves immediately and raises Profile.RibbonChanged so every other window/workspace on the profile reloads its strip live; the originating window skips its own reload.

ribbon-defaults.title: Bundled Default Items
ribbon-defaults.description: The shipped default-ribbon.json seeded on first run (or Reset / empty ribbon): Projects · This PC · AI Chat · Scratchpad · Processes · Documents/Pictures/Videos/Music. Known-folder tokens ({Documents}, {Pictures}, …) expand to real paths at load.

theme-system.title: Theming System
theme-system.description: The layered theme engine: how a theme is built, switched, frozen and extended, and the shared colour banks every region and feature binds.

theme-layered-assembly.title: Layered Assembly
theme-layered-assembly.description: ThemeManager.Apply merges five dictionaries in fixed precedence order — palette -> region tokens -> feature contributions -> per-theme overrides + scenes -> styles — skipping missing optional layers.

theme-base-palette.title: Base Palette
theme-base-palette.description: Layer 1: each Colors.<Theme>.xaml supplies the same structural key set (Bg/Surface/Accent/Text/... as Color + Brush) plus gradients and chrome dimensions; deliberately tone-neutral (no GreenBrush/OrangeBrush).

theme-region-tokens.title: Region Tokens
theme-region-tokens.description: Layer 2 ({Region}.{Role} keys in Tokens.xaml): each shell region (Chrome/Ribbon/TabStrip/AiBar/FileList/...) binds its own namespaced colour handle that default-aliases the palette, so a theme can restyle one region without touching the rest.

theme-themed-region.title: ThemedRegion + Scene Backdrops
theme-themed-region.description: The generic ThemedRegion wrapper renders three layers behind any named region's content — a Scene.<Region> animated backdrop, a {Region}.Bg tint veil, then the content; inert (zero extra visuals) when a theme supplies neither.

theme-scene-ocean.title: OceanReefScene
theme-scene-ocean.description: Procedural reef backdrop (sun glow, god rays, floor caustics, drifting fish, swaying coral, rising bubbles); density scales with region size and it never hit-tests. Theme art for Ocean's Scene.Window.

theme-scene-forest.title: ForestScene
theme-scene-forest.description: Dappled-woodland backdrop — warm canopy light fading to a shaded forest floor; drives Nature's Scene.Window.

theme-scene-gothic.title: GothicScene
theme-scene-gothic.description: Midnight backdrop — near-black sky with a bruised-purple moon bloom over a tower and fog; drives Gothic's Scene.Window.

theme-scene-sandstone.title: SandstoneWall
theme-scene-sandstone.description: Warm cut-stone masonry backdrop lit by a slowly travelling sun; drives Sandstone's Scene.Window.

theme-scene-sunny.title: SunnyScene
theme-scene-sunny.description: Bright cheerful sky warming toward the horizon, with drifting balloons/confetti; drives Sunny's Scene.Window (proves the scene mechanism works for light themes too).

theme-swatch-bank.title: Categorical Swatch Bank
theme-swatch-bank.description: Swatch.* — a dozen mutually-distinct hues for components needing recognisably different colours next to one another (pie/chart series, category dots, colour pickers); defaults in Tokens.xaml, art-directed per theme.

title_path: Rule: a feature never hard-codes a colour

theme-textswatch-palette.title: Code Colour Palette (TextSwatch)
theme-textswatch-palette.description: TextSwatch.* — role-named tokens (Comment/Keyword/String/Number/Type/Function/...) the editor colourizers read at paint time for syntax highlighting; kept separate from Swatch.* so each theme art-directs code to its own mood.

theme-semantic-tokens.title: Semantic Status Tokens
theme-semantic-tokens.description: Meaning-not-tone brushes (SuccessBrush/WarningBrush/DangerBrush, OnAccentBrush, AccentSubtleBrush, AiStatus.* dot states) kept mutually distinct so success/warning/danger never blend; defaults in Tokens.xaml.

theme-contribution.title: Feature Theme Contributions
theme-contribution.description: IThemeContribution lets a feature ship fallback theme resources (pack-URI ResourceDictionaries) discovered by reflection and merged at layer 3 — below the active theme, so a theme can override any contributed key by string name with no Core<->feature reference.

theme-selection.title: Theme Selection (Options)
theme-selection.description: Options > Shell exposes a Theme combo with a live colour-swatch preview; the chosen ThemeOption is saved to ShellConfig and (per the inline notice) takes effect on window restart.

theme-switch-restart.title: Theme Switch (Window Restart)
theme-switch-restart.description: Because brushes bind via {StaticResource} (resolved once, for render perf), switching theme re-runs ThemeManager.Apply then RestartWindowForTheme rebuilds the acting window in place — same position, same tabs (order + active preserved) — against the new theme.

theme-freeze-on-merge.title: Freeze-on-Merge
theme-freeze-on-merge.description: After all layers merge, FreezeResources freezes every Freezable resource (brushes/gradients/effects) so they are immutable, thread-safe to read from per-window UI threads, and skip per-use change tracking; best-effort per key.

ws-profile-selector.title: Profile Selector
ws-profile-selector.description: The coloured icon button in the window chrome showing the active profile's symbol on its colour. Left-click opens a popup list of all profiles to switch the active workspace; right-click opens a Configure / New-workspace menu. Disabled (no switch) while a modal overlay is open.

ws-switch-profile.title: Switch Profile
ws-switch-profile.description: Picking a profile from the selector popup reconfigures the current workspace in place: cancels any in-flight AI send, collapses to this window (closing the others), repoints to the new profile, closes tabs, and rebuilds providers + AIService + ribbon. Modal overlays block switching.

ws-modal-block-switch.title: Modal Switch Block
ws-modal-block-switch.description: While the Options or Manage-AI/Configure overlay is open, profile switching and the selector's right-click menu are disabled (CanSwitchProfile is false) — those panels edit the active workspace/profile, so the workspace must stay put.

ws-options-list.title: Workspaces List (Options)
ws-options-list.description: The Options → Workspaces page: one editable row per profile (icon tile, name, symbol, colour) with per-row Configure / Clone / Delete actions and an '+ Add Workspace' button. Backed by editable row copies that only commit on Apply.

ws-clone.title: Clone Workspace
ws-clone.description: Duplicates a profile with a fresh icon/colour, copying its AI config, persona and provider configs into a new on-disk folder. Available both as the Options list 'Clone' button and as the selector's right-click 'New workspace…' (which clones the current one and opens Configure on it).

ws-delete.title: Delete Workspace
ws-delete.description: Permanently removes a profile and its on-disk data (config + every conversation). Confirmation-gated; refuses the last remaining profile and one a live workspace uses (the Options 'Delete' button is hidden for the active workspace). The Configure panel's Delete closes the workspace's windows first, then deletes.

ws-reorder.title: Reorder Workspaces
ws-reorder.description: Drag the icon tile of a row in the Options list to reorder profiles; a ghost-frame adorner follows the cursor. The edited order syncs to the live Profiles list (and the selector dropdown / JumpList) on Apply.

ws-identity.title: Identity Editor
ws-identity.description: First page of the Configure panel: edit a workspace's Name, Symbol and Colour against an in-memory copy with a live preview tile, committing only on Apply (a rename moves the on-disk data folder). Includes inline validation (non-empty, no name collision).

ws-colour-swatches.title: Colour Swatches
ws-colour-swatches.description: Per-profile colour picker drawing from the shared categorical Swatch.* bank (Blue/Cyan/Teal/…/Slate), plus a hex text box. Same bank in the Options list and the Configure identity page so both offer the theme's palette; throws on a missing swatch key.

ws-reconfigure-in-place.title: Reconfigure In Place
ws-reconfigure-in-place.description: After a provider-config or grid change the workspace's runtime is rebuilt for its current profile: tabs close, the feature cache is evicted, providers are re-acquired (warming new models, cooling dropped ones) and the AIService rebuilt, then a default tab reopens. A workspace-scoped feature-config change instead does a full RestartWorkspace (fresh workspace + swapped window).

ws-export-conversations.title: Export Conversations
ws-export-conversations.description: Identity page action: pick a folder (via the themed folder picker) and save every conversation in this workspace as markdown files (one per conversation), with a toast reporting the count.

ws-jumplist.title: Taskbar JumpList
ws-jumplist.description: A Windows taskbar JumpList with one 'Workspaces' task per profile, each launching the exe with --context "Name" to open straight into that profile. Rebuilt whenever the profile list changes; failures are swallowed (cosmetic).

ws-single-instance-ipc.title: Single-Instance IPC
ws-single-instance-ipc.description: A single-instance guard: a second launch doesn't start a new process — it forwards a new-window request (honouring --context) over IPC to the running instance, which opens a window in a NEW workspace. The IPC listener is started during app init.

ws-prestart-daemon.title: Resident Daemon (--prestart)
ws-prestart-daemon.description: Launched with --prestart, the app initialises fully but shows no window and creates no workspace — it stays resident after init so the next click/JumpList signal opens a window instantly. It also stays alive windowless instead of shutting down on last-window-close (unless an update is committing).

win-cux-split-empty.title: Split Empty Pane
win-cux-split-empty.description: Adds an empty right-hand pane to an unsplit window, focusing it so the next opened tab lands there. Disabled once already split (v1 is two panes max).

win-cux-close-pane.title: Close Pane
win-cux-close-pane.description: Collapses the split back to one pane, moving the closed pane's tabs into the survivor (remove-then-add so each PaneView releases and re-adopts the page control).

win-cux-open-in-new-window.title: Open in New Window
win-cux-open-in-new-window.description: Spawns a fresh shell window in the current workspace and opens the chosen page in it. Exposed by the ribbon item / tab context-menu 'Open in New Window' action.

win-cux-tab-drag-transfer.title: Cross-Window Tab Drag
win-cux-tab-drag-transfer.description: Drag a tab and drop it onto another pane or another window's tab strip to move it there. Within a window it moves between panes; across windows ShellServices re-keys the tab from its source window to the drop target. Dropping off all windows tears it off into a new one.

win-cux-window-registry.title: Multi-Window Registry
win-cux-window-registry.description: ShellServices tracks every open window of a workspace and which window owns each tab, tracks the focused window (new tabs / AI context route there), and on last-window-close releases the workspace's resources (and quits the app when no window remains anywhere, unless resident).

win-cux-dpi-placement.title: DPI-Aware Placement
win-cux-dpi-placement.description: Window-positioning helpers that read the cursor's monitor DPI and work area so torn-off windows drop at the cursor, replacement windows reopen where the old one was, and a follow-up window opens on the same monitor — all in WPF logical pixels.

win-cux-file-picker.title: Themed File Picker
win-cux-file-picker.description: An in-app, theme-styled Open/Save file browser (drive-rooted tree, extension filtering, double-click to confirm) used instead of the OS dialog. Reused via IShellServices.PickOpenFileAsync / PickSaveFileAsync, owned by the focused window.

win-cux-folder-picker.title: Themed Folder Picker
win-cux-folder-picker.description: An in-app, theme-styled folder browser (drive-rooted directory tree, pre-expands to an initial path) used instead of the OS dialog. Reused via IShellServices.PickFolderAsync and by Export Conversations, owned by the focused window.

visuals-text.title: Visuals.Text
visuals-text.description: Shared WPF text stack (Nexaflow.Visuals.Text): the markdown render/diagram engine AND the AvalonEdit-based code/text editor. Used by Core's AI overlay + 7 features.

vtext-editor.title: Code/Text Editor
vtext-editor.description: The shared AvalonEdit editor surface (windowed document, encoding/EOL options, built-in commands) reused by the Code, Text and Markdown editors.

vtext-editor-host.title: Editor Host
vtext-editor-host.description: FileTextEditorView/ViewModel: the document host, line numbers, selection, find, the editor command surface.

vtext-highlighting.title: Highlighting Host
vtext-highlighting.description: Binds the Syntax engine into AvalonEdit: HighlightingRegistry (ext→engine), TreeSitterColorizer (paints spans), XshdTheming (retints built-in defs to the theme).

vtext-codeblock.title: CodeBlockView
vtext-codeblock.description: Read-only syntax-highlighted code block, reused by the Notebook code cells and markdown fenced code.

vtext-selectable-markdown.title: Selectable Markdown
vtext-selectable-markdown.description: SelectableMarkdownView / MarkdownFlowDocument: copy-aware rendered markdown used by the AI overlay and AIChat.

vtext-pipeline.title: Markdown Pipeline
vtext-pipeline.description: The single shared Markdig pipeline (MarkdownPipelineFactory) every markdown surface parses with.

syntax.title: Syntax Engine (tree-sitter)
syntax.description: Nexaflow.Syntax: the tree-sitter parse + highlight engine. Shared by the Code editor, Notebook, Product Manager and Visuals.Text.

syntax-queries.title: Highlight Queries
syntax-queries.description: Per-grammar capture→role queries that drive colouring.

syntax-injections.title: Embedded Languages
syntax-injections.description: LanguageInjections: finds embedded sub-ranges (JS/CSS in HTML, Ruby in ERB, SQL in heredocs) and re-parses them, recursing.

syntax-parse-tree.title: Parse Tree (AI)
syntax-parse-tree.description: CodeHighlighter.GetParseTree → the s-expression syntax tree exposed to the AI / graphify (get_syntax_tree).

syntax-outline.title: Code Outline / Structure
syntax-outline.description: CodeOutline + CodeStructureExtractor: the class/structure map data behind the Code editor's class view.

visuals-terminal.title: Visuals.Terminal
visuals-terminal.description: Shared terminal control (Nexaflow.Visuals.Terminal): VT rendering, view-model, command classification, key/history handling. Used by Core + the Console feature.

vterm-view.title: Terminal View
vterm-view.description: TerminalView: the VT/ANSI render surface with selection, copy and scrollback.

vterm-classifier.title: Command Classifier
vterm-classifier.description: CommandClassifier: decides whether typed input is a shell command or an AI prompt.

vterm-keys.title: Keys & History
vterm-keys.description: TerminalKeys: key handling, command history, and Tab completion plumbing.

vterm-environments.title: Environments Model
vterm-environments.description: Per-location terminal environments (TerminalEnvironment / EnvVar / EnvScope) the Console binds master/detail.

io-terminal.title: IO.Terminal (PTY)
io-terminal.description: Nexaflow.IO.Terminal: the pseudo-console (ConPTY) backend — process host, VT screen state, job-object lifetime. Used by Visuals.Terminal + Console.

ioterm-screen.title: Terminal Screen
ioterm-screen.description: TerminalScreen: the VT parser / screen-buffer state.

ioterm-job.title: Process Lifetime
ioterm-job.description: TerminalJobObject: ties the child process tree to the tab so it's torn down cleanly.

io-common.title: IO.Common
io-common.description: Nexaflow.IO.Common: WPF-free file leaves shared by ~18 consumers — encoding sniff, file watching, glob, text transforms, and the archive virtual-filesystem facade.

iocommon-encoding.title: Encoding Detector
iocommon-encoding.description: EncodingDetector: BOM + UTF-8 sniff (the canonical detector reused by the text/log/tabular readers).

iocommon-filewatch.title: File Change Watcher
iocommon-filewatch.description: FileChangeWatcher: debounced FileSystemWatcher wrapper behind IShellServices.WatchFile.

iocommon-glob.title: Glob
iocommon-glob.description: Glob: the shared glob matcher (folder-action content rules, file-map criteria).

iocommon-vfs.title: Virtual File System
iocommon-vfs.description: IVirtualFileSystem / VirtualFileSystem / VirtualEntry: the facade that lets the file explorer browse archives like folders.

iocommon-codecs.title: Codec / Archive Contracts
iocommon-codecs.description: IStreamCodec / IArchiveHandler / IArchiveEncryptor: the contracts the Compressed backends implement.

iocommon-transforms.title: Text Transforms & Hashing
iocommon-transforms.description: TextTransforms, LineEnding, Base64Codec, Hashing, FileSplitter — shared byte/text utilities.

visuals-common.title: Visuals.Common
visuals-common.description: Nexaflow.Visuals.Common: the shared WPF controls, converters and formatters used by Core and nearly every feature view.

vcommon-controls.title: Shared Controls
vcommon-controls.description: PieChart, SparklineChart, SunburstControl (the Product sunburst), ThemedRegion (the animated-scene region wrapper).

vcommon-converters.title: Value Converters
vcommon-converters.description: The shared converter bank (Bool/Null/Count/Enum/String→Visibility, ColorString→Brush, …) used across feature XAML.

vcommon-formatters.title: Formatters
vcommon-formatters.description: SizeFormatter, DurationFormatter and BytesToTextConverter — shared human-readable formatting.

vcommon-collections.title: Collections
vcommon-collections.description: RangeObservableCollection: batched add/clear to avoid per-item CollectionChanged churn.

providers-common.title: Providers.Common
providers-common.description: Shared provider contracts: ILlmProvider, the Llm message/response/attachment types, ProviderModel, IProviderConfig.

projects-buckets.title: Archive / Shelf / Reactivate
projects-buckets.description: Project lifecycle: Archive and Shelf move a project to its configured folder and Reactivate moves it back, via a safe background copy-then-delete (IShellServices.MoveFolderInBackground) that shows a Moving project... pane and refreshes when done.

projects-migration.title: Schema migration (v2)
projects-migration.description: The .project file is schema v2; legacy files load tolerantly in memory and prompt to upgrade, folding Scope / Notes / Implementation Plan / Test Plan into the new markdown fields and objectives into completion criteria.

projects-backlog-viewlet.title: Backlog folder viewlet
projects-backlog-viewlet.description: File-explorer viewlet shown when a folder contains a .project: a per-status backlog breakdown (coloured chips) plus an Open project shortcut; a single-bar with a left logo strip.

projects-backlog-ai.title: Task to AI / Plan with AI
projects-backlog-ai.description: Two backlog-editor buttons that open a new conversation seeded with the item and the project folder pinned as a FileSystem context item, auto-sending a perform-this-task or plan prompt.
